book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.arcan: The arrays catalogued in this chapter range from simple [#](8B0000)crafting arrays[#]() that reshape matter, to complex inscriptions that forge [#](4A0080)sigils[#](), bind [#](4A0080)living armour[#](), and even bend the passage of time. Master the fundamentals, and the rest shall follow.
The foundation of all vitaemantic craft, circles drawn in ash, awaiting purpose.

A second item placed becomes the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](). If both are valid, the array awakens and its working begins. Base and catalyst together define the array's effect: a transmutation, an enchantment, a binding.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Watch the pattern carefully when you place the base. If the glyph changes form, you are on the right path.[#]()

Before sigils, before rituals, before the great workings of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() were ever conceived, there was the [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Drawn in [#](8B0000)Arcane Ashes[#]() upon bare stone or earth, the array is the most fundamental expression of the art , a circle of intent, waiting to be given purpose.

To inscribe an array, hold [#](8B0000)Arcane Ashes[#]() and press [Use] upon a solid surface. Each inscription consumes one charge from the ashes, which hold twenty uses before crumbling to dust.\
\
The empty array is inert. Click it with an item to place the [#](8B0000)base[#]() component. The design shifts if the base is recognized.
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.craft: The simplest array, inscribe essence onto matter and reshape it.

Some crafting arrays require only common materials. Others demand reagents forged through more advanced means; the complexity of the product mirrors the complexity of the path to reach it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Most sigils, reagents, and bindings begin their existence within a crafting array. Master this foundation well.[#]()

[#](8B0000)Crafting Arrays[#]() are among the simplest expressions of the art. The array inscribes the essence of the [#](8B0000)base[#]() onto the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](), transmuting both into something new. A brief, elegant animation accompanies the transformation.
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.downg: The armour craves combat; starve it of violence, and it starves you.

The armour develops a bloodlust that seeps into your belly. If you fail to attack something recently, gnawing hunger overtakes you. Higher levels shorten the grace period and intensify the starvation.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armour feeds on violence. Deny it, and it feeds on you instead.[#]()
Battle Hungry
Battle Hungry
The armour drags you down; water becomes a grave.

The armour grows dense and waterlogged, dragging you down through liquid like an anchor. Reduces swim speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The depths call, and the armour answers on your behalf.[#]()
Concrete Shoes
Concrete Shoes
The armour locks your off-hand; one arm must suffice.

The armour seizes your off-hand in a rigid grip, preventing you from using whatever you hold there. No torches, no shields, no secondary tools.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armour demands your undivided attention.[#]()
Crippled Arm
Crippled Arm
The armour festers, choking your body's ability to heal.

The armour's living tissue sickens, suppressing your body's ability to mend. All healing is reduced by up to 80%%; a wound that should restore ten hearts barely returns two.\
\
[#](4A0080)What lives can also sicken.[#]()
Diseased
Diseased
The armour bleeds your strength; every strike lands softer.

The armour saps the force behind your strikes, blunting every blow. Reduces melee damage by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)Your sword arm weakens as the armour feeds elsewhere.[#]()
Dulled Blade
Dulled Blade
The armour drags at your arms; mining becomes a crawl.

The armour weighs upon your arms, making every swing of the pick feel like moving through tar. Reduces dig speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The stone mocks your feeble blows.[#]()
Leadened Pick
Leadened Pick
The armour hobbles your stride; each step heavier than the last.

The armour stiffens around your legs, hobbling your stride. Reduces movement speed by up to 70%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10\
\
[#](4A0080)Every step is a negotiation with the armour's weight.[#]()
Limp Leg
Limp Leg
The armour seals your throat; no potion shall pass your lips.

The armour rejects all liquid sustenance, clamping your throat shut against any potion you attempt to consume. No healing draughts, no buffs, no alchemical aids.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armour alone shall sustain you, or so it believes.[#]()
Quenched
Quenched
The armour ruins your aim; every shot goes astray.

The armour interferes with your aim, introducing wild inaccuracy to every arrow and bolt you loose. Bows and crossbows become exercises in frustration.\
\
[#](4A0080)Your hands are steady. The armour is not.[#]()
Storm Trooper
Storm Trooper
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.livin:
The [#](8B0000)Ritual of Binding[#](): [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base, an iron armour piece as catalyst.\
\
The armour is alive, and it watches everything you do. Be deliberate in what you teach it. [#](2E8B57)Hold sneak while examining a piece to see what it has learned so far.[#]()

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](), then apply the [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base. Place your [#](8B0000)Iron Helmet[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Chestplate[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Leggings[#](), or [#](8B0000)Iron Boots[#]() as catalyst, and step back.\
\
The armour begins equivalent to iron, but possesses 100 [#](B8860B)Upgrade Points[#]() that it will spend as it grows alongside you. There may be ways to surpass this limitation...
Armour that breathes, learns, and grows alongside its wearer.

To create [#](8B0000)Living Equipment[#](), you require [#](8B0000)Iron Armour[#](), [#](8B0000)Arcane Ashes[#](), a [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#](), and at least a [#](8B0000)Common Spiritus Gem[#]() charged with sufficient [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). What emerges is no longer mere metal; it is alive, and it learns from you.

The [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Living Equipment[#]() matches [#](B8860B)Diamond[#]() in durability and can be repaired in an [#](8B0000)Anvil[#]() with additional [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]().
The armour learns from your deeds; guide its growth with care.

You have felt it, the armour shifting, adapting, straining to assist you in whatever task it observes. It grows in many directions at once, but its capacity is finite. Trying to master everything yields mastery of nothing.

Consider forging multiple sets, each trained for a specific purpose. A miner's set, a warrior's set, an explorer's set; specialization is the path to true power.\
\
You have devised [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() to assist with focused training, and another to imbue your armour with a greater capacity for growth.
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.movem: Arrays of force, hurl creatures and objects with vitaemantic velocity.

A pair of arrays designed to hurl anything that crosses their threshold, players, creatures, loose items alike. One propels horizontally in the direction the entity faces; the other launches straight upward.

[#](8B0000)Speed Array[#](): Launches entities horizontally in the direction they face. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Updraft Array[#](): Hurls entities skyward with considerable force. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Useful for rapid transit systems, mob processing, or simply entertaining oneself at a guest's expense.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.name: Alchemy Arrays
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.sigil: Command the wind to hurl you skyward, at your own peril.

The [#](8B0000)Air Sigil[#]() hurls you through the sky in whatever direction you face, trading 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() for each burst of momentum. The wind obeys, but gravity does not; this sigil offers no protection from the landing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)More than one overconfident apprentice has drained their [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() mid-flight. Know your reserves before you leap.[#]()
Air Sigil
Air Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Air Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The sky remembers every mage who forgot to look down.[#]()

The sigil remembers a [#](8B0000)brightness level[#]() from 1 to 15. Left-click the air to cycle the brightness upward. Sneak and left-click to cycle it downward. The current setting is shown in the sigil's tooltip.\
\
Once a blood light has been placed, you can also adjust it directly. Right-click an existing blood light with the sigil to increase its brightness, or sneak and right-click to dim it. Adjusting an existing light costs no [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().
Brightness Control
Cast colored motes of blood-light into the darkness ahead of you.

Blood lights are not limited to their natural crimson. Combine the sigil with any vanilla [#](8B0000)dye[#]() in a shapeless craft to change its color. All other data on the sigil, including its binding and brightness setting, is preserved.\
\
Lights placed after dyeing will glow in the chosen color. To restore the default red, simply place the sigil alone in a crafting grid.
Color Dyeing

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Blood Lamp[#]() launches a mote of crystallized [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() in the direction you face. When it strikes a surface, it anchors itself as a permanent floating light source at a cost of merely 10 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, right-clicking a nearby surface places the light directly without launching a projectile.
Sigil of the Blood Lamp
Sigil of the Blood Lamp

Forge the [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)A small light to banish the deepest dark, in any color you desire.[#]()
A lens into the unseen, reveals the state of your Anima and Ara Vitae.

Hold sneak and press [Use] to open a configuration interface. Here you may reposition the various [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() display elements on your field of vision. Click and drag to move them, then select Save to preserve the arrangement, or Default to restore the original positions.

The configurable displays are:

- The Incense Altar (light grey)

- The Seer's Sigil (purple)

- The Divination Sigil (lavender)

- The Spiritus Aura Gauge (orange)

- The Sigil of Holding (green)

The [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() is the first lens through which a Vitaemancer peers into the invisible currents of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() that sustain all vitaemantic works. Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from humble components, it reveals what the naked eye cannot.
Divination Sigil
Divination Sigil

Inscribe the array with [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() as the base and a [#](8B0000)Blank Slate[#]() as the catalyst. The sigil that emerges thrums faintly with awareness.\
\
[#](4A0080)To see is to begin understanding.[#]()

The sigil serves two vital purposes:

- Activate it toward open air to reveal the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() stored within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), the measure of your reserves.

- Aim it at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to reveal the altar's current tier, the volume of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within, and its maximum capacity.
Feed life into the soil and watch the world bloom around you.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Green Grove[#]() channels [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into the living earth, coaxing plants to grow with unnatural speed. A marriage of blood and botany that any practitioner with a garden will find indispensable.
Sigil of the Green Grove
Sigil of the Green Grove

Forge the [#](8B0000)Growth Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Reinforced Slate[#]() as catalyst.

Aim at a growable block and press [Use] to apply a burst of growth for 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle a persistent aura. While active, every block within a 7x7x5 volume centered on you receives a growth pulse every 5 seconds, at a cost of 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per cycle.
Carry five sigils in one, their power at your fingertips.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Holding[#]() is a vessel within a vessel, capable of containing up to five other [#](8B0000)Sigils[#]() simultaneously. While held, it channels their passive effects and allows you to activate any of them at will.\
\
Press the Open Holding keybind to access its inventory. Use the cycle keybinds or hold sneak and scroll to switch between stored sigils.
Sigil of Holding
Sigil of Holding

Forge the [#](8B0000)Holding Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)One hand to hold the world's power.[#]()
Walk upon water made solid by the chill of your Anima.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Frozen Lake[#]() chills the water beneath your feet as you walk, crystallizing it into solid ice within a two-block radius. The effect is reminiscent of ancient frost enchantments, but drawn from [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() rather than arcane inscriptions.\
\
Toggle it with sneak and [Use]. The ice endures only as long as you remain near.
Sigil of the Frozen Lake
Sigil of the Frozen Lake
Summon molten stone at a steep cost to your Anima.

Sister to the [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#](), the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() draws molten stone from the depths of your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() at a cost of 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The price reflects the violence of the element, and if your reserves cannot bear it, five hearts are torn from your flesh instead.
Lava Sigil
Lava Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Lava Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Blank Slate[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)Handle with the reverence due to hellfire.[#]()

Like its cooler counterpart, the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() may serve as a component in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() to automate the production of [#](8B0000)Lava Buckets[#](). The sigil is not consumed.
Extend your reach; items drift toward you unbidden.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Magnetism[#]() bends the subtle forces between you and nearby objects, extending your item pickup range to 7 blocks while active. Hold the sigil, then hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle the effect.\
\
The sigil drains 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while its pull persists.
Sigil of Magnetism
Sigil of Magnetism

Forge the [#](8B0000)Magnetism Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The world draws near to those who command it.[#]()
Blood-fueled haste for those who delve deep.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Miner[#]() infuses your muscles with vitaemantic vigor, granting the Haste effect while active. Stone yields faster, timber falls quicker, earth parts more readily.\
\
Toggle with sneak and [Use]. Drains 100 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while the effect persists.
Sigil of the Fast Miner
Sigil of the Fast Miner

Forge the [#](8B0000)Mining Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Reinforced Slate[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The earth parts before the blood-quickened hand.[#]()
Walk upon crystallized EV, a bridge born of blood beneath your feet.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Bridge[#]() crystallizes [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into temporary platforms beneath your feet as you walk. These spectral surfaces allow you to traverse chasms, voids, and open sky with the confidence of solid ground.\
\
The phantom blocks dissolve shortly after you leave them behind. [#](2E8B57)Keep moving; hesitation over the abyss is unwise.[#]()
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge

Forge the [#](8B0000)Phantom Bridge Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)Between you and the void, blood is the only bridge you need.[#]()
A deeper sight, reveals the full workings of the Ara Vitae.

When aimed at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), the Seer's display reveals, from top to bottom:

- The altar's current [#](B8860B)Tier[#]()

- Current [#](4A0080)EV[#]() volume and total capacity

- Active crafting progress, if any

- [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() consumed per tick during crafting

- Current [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() reserve held by Charging Runes

Where the [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() offers a glimpse, the [#](8B0000)Seer's Sigil[#]() opens your perception wide. It reveals not only the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), but lays bare the inner workings of the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() itself , crafting progress, consumption rates, and more.\
\
It also provides the same display configuration as its lesser counterpart.
Seer's Sigil
Seer's Sigil

First, forge the [#](8B0000)Sight Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](). Then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)When mere sight is no longer sufficient.[#]()
Command the elements to part; fluid yields to your presence.

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Suppression[#]() exerts your will upon the elements themselves, temporarily banishing all fluids within roughly six blocks of you. The liquid vanishes as though it never existed, returning only after you move away.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A powerful tool for traversing Nether lava oceans. But be wary of deep water; deactivating above a chasm invites a swift end.[#]()
Sigil of Suppression
Sigil of Suppression

Forge the [#](8B0000)Suppression Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The elements themselves bow before sufficient will.[#]()
Tear through space itself to reach a bound Teleposer.

The [#](8B0000)Teleposition Sigil[#]() tears a momentary rift between you and a linked [#](8B0000)Teleposer[#](), pulling you across any distance, even between dimensions, for 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Sneak-click on a [#](8B0000)Teleposer[#]() to bind its location to the sigil. [#](2E8B57)Do not move the Teleposer afterward, or you may find yourself arriving somewhere... unexpected.[#]()
Teleposition Sigil
Teleposition Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Teleposition Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The distance between here and there is merely a matter of blood.[#]()
Erase fluid from existence with a single gesture.

The [#](8B0000)Void Sigil[#]() annihilates fluid on contact, consuming 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per block erased. Aim at any liquid and press [Use] to watch it vanish without a trace.\
\
Invaluable for clearing treacherous lava flows or unwanted floods without the tedium of conventional methods.
Void Sigil
Void Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Void Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)What the void takes, it does not return.[#]()
Conjure water from the currents of your Anima.

The [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() conjures a source of water from nothing, drawn from the currents of your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() at a cost of 100 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per use. Aim at any solid surface and press [Use].\
\
Should your reserves prove insufficient, the sigil draws the toll from your own blood instead.
Water Sigil
Water Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Water Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Blank Slate[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)An endless spring, born of sacrifice.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() may also serve as a component in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), automating the production of [#](8B0000)Water Buckets[#](). The sigil itself is not consumed in this process.
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.spike: An invisible ward that punishes those who tread upon it.

The [#](8B0000)Spike Array[#]() is a cruel but effective ward. Any living creature that steps onto it suffers a full heart of damage. The array is nearly invisible once inscribed, making it ideal for defending passages or feeding certain... automated arrangements.

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() and apply the appropriate base and catalyst to form the spike glyph.\
\
[#](4A0080)The floor remembers every trespass.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.time_: Bend the sky's clock, summon dawn or hasten dusk.

Among the most audacious workings in [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() are these arrays that bend the passage of time itself. Once activated, the inscribed components are consumed as the sky obeys.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Day[#]() array advances the world to the next sunrise. The [#](8B0000)Night[#]() array draws it forward to the next sunset.

[#](8B0000)New Dawn[#](): Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Commands the sun to rise.\
\
[#](8B0000)True Twilight[#](): Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Beckons the fall of night.\
\
[#](4A0080)Time is not yours to own, only to borrow.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.train: A focus of discipline, control what your living armour learns.

The armour's undirected growth can be maddening. To impose order upon it, you have devised the [#](8B0000)Training Bracelet[#](), a focus that allows you to dictate which abilities the armour should pursue and which it should ignore.\
\
Press [Use] to open its configuration menu.

The [#](8B0000)Training Bracelet[#]() is forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
Only one bracelet is active at a time. Priority order: off-hand, Curios slots (if available), main inventory, then any add-on inventories.

With a copy of the relevant [#](8B0000)Tome[#]() in hand, you can set a level cap for any upgrade. Once the armour reaches that limit, it ceases training that skill.\
\
[#](2E8B57)To allow all upgrades except one: set the bracelet to 'allow others' mode and cap the unwanted skill at level 0.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.alchemy_arrays.upgra: Feed yourself well and the armour fortifies your body in turn.

The armour observes your habits of nourishment and responds in kind, hardening your frame against impact. Grants [#](4A0080)Knockback Resistance[#]() up to 100%% and bonus health up to 10 half-hearts.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Eating food.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Body Builder
Body Builder
Inscribe knowledge upon tomes, and the armour crystallizes into diamond-like hardness.

The armour responds to the knowledge you inscribe upon living tomes, hardening its lattice with each lesson. Grants up to +5 [#](4A0080)Armour[#]() and +8 [#](4A0080)Toughness[#]().\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Crafting a living tome in the Tabula Vitae. Each tome grants 1 level.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Brilliance
Brilliance
Your momentum becomes a weapon; the faster you charge, the harder you strike.

The armour learns to channel your momentum into devastating force. Sprinting attacks deal increased damage and knockback, up to +50%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Dealing damage while sprinting.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 5
Charging Strike
Charging Strike
The armour grows sockets to hold your vitaemantic trinkets.

The armour opens hidden recesses within itself, forming [#](8B0000)Living Armour Socket[#]() slots that can hold compatible [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() trinkets.\
\
This upgrade cannot be trained; only inscribed via [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tome[#](). Each tome adds one additional socket.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Requires the Curios API.[#]()
Socketed
Socketed
The deeper you dig, the faster the armour drives your arms.

The armour recognizes the rhythm of the pick. Mining identical blocks in succession accelerates your speed, and at higher levels a surge of [#](4A0080)Haste[#]() follows each broken block.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Mining blocks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Dwarven Might
Dwarven Might
Wings of living tissue unfurl from the chestplate, take to the sky.

The armour sprouts membranes of living tissue, granting true flight. This upgrade cannot be trained; it must be inscribed via [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tome[#]().\
\
The wings consume durability from the chestplate, though at half the rate of conventional elytra. The aesthetic is, admittedly, rather striking.
Elytra
Elytra

The [#](8B0000)Elytra Tome[#]() is forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Apply it to your [#](8B0000)Living Chestplate[#]() to unfurl the wings.\
\
[#](4A0080)Blood gave you life. Now it gives you the sky.[#]()
The armour draws deeper knowledge from each fallen foe.

The armour learns to amplify the resonance of slain creatures, drawing forth greater experience from each kill. Increases XP drops up to 150%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Collecting experience orbs.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Experienced
Experienced
Each blow teaches the armour to sharpen the next.

The armour studies each blow you deliver and sharpens your killing edge in response. Melee attacks deal progressively greater damage.\
\
[#](B8860B)Trained by[#](): Performing melee attacks.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10
Fierce Strike
Fierce Strike
The armour remembers the flame and learns to refuse it.

The armour absorbs the memory of flame and learns to shield you from it. Grants [#](4A0080)Fire Resistance[#](). Higher levels extend the duration and reduce the cooldown between activations.\
\

book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.archmage:
Forge the [#](8B0000)Archmage Blood Orb[#]() in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 5[#](), cost: 80,000 EV).\
\
[#](2E8B57)Should even this not sate your ambitions, the Runes of the Orb can stretch your Anima further still.[#]()
When you first grip a bindable item and will it to life, it imprints upon your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](). From that moment forward, any [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() cost the item demands is drawn from your network. Should the [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() run dry, some items will take payment directly from your flesh instead.\
\
Other workings, such as a hungry [#](8B0000)Ritual[#]() that has drained you completely, inflict unceasing nausea until the ritual is silenced or your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() is replenished.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.descript: The invisible reservoir of EV that binds your soul to all vitaemantic works.
To fill your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](), you require a [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#](), a crystallized anchor between your soul and the altar's power.

- Right-click with the orb in hand to sacrifice one heart, channeling [#](8B0000)200 EV[#]() into your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]().

- Place the orb within an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() brimming with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The orb drinks deeply, limited only by your altar's [#](8B0000)Speed Runes[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.intro.te: Beneath the surface of the world lies an invisible lattice of living energy, your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](). This is the network that binds your soul to every sigil you wield, every ritual you ignite, every vitaemantic instrument you have ever touched. Think of it as a vast, hidden reservoir of [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#](), life-force refined and stored beyond the physical realm, unique to you alone.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.magician:
Forge the [#](8B0000)Magician Blood Orb[#]() in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 3[#](), cost: 25,000 EV).\
\
Forge the [#](8B0000)Master Blood Orb[#]() in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 4[#](), cost: 50,000 EV).
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.name: The Anima
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.orb_tier:
Each tier of the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() unlocks a more potent orb, expanding the boundaries of your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]().

- [#](B8860B)Weak Blood Orb[#](): Capacity: [#](8B0000)5,000 EV[#]().

- [#](B8860B)Apprentice Blood Orb[#](): Capacity: [#](8B0000)25,000 EV[#]().

- [#](B8860B)Magician Blood Orb[#](): Capacity: [#](8B0000)150,000 EV[#]().

- [#](B8860B)Master Blood Orb[#](): Capacity: [#](8B0000)1,000,000 EV[#]().

- [#](B8860B)Archmage Blood Orb[#](): Capacity: [#](8B0000)10,000,000 EV[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.altar.anima.weak_app:
Forge the [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Orb[#]() in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 1[#](), cost: 2,000 EV).\
\
Forge the [#](8B0000)Apprentice Blood Orb[#]() in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 2[#](), cost: 5,000 EV).
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.blan: To ascend to greater tiers, you must inscribe [#](8B0000)Blood Runes[#]() and arrange them around the altar in precise patterns. Specialized runes confer different blessings upon the altar's workings. The most basic, the [#](8B0000)Blank Rune[#](), carries no enchantment of its own, serving only as structural scaffolding for the altar's ascension.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.craf:
The moment an item is laid upon the altar, the [#](4A0080)transmutation[#]() begins. [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() drains steadily from the basin; crimson motes rising from the surface confirm the process is underway.\
\
Should the altar run dry, gray smoke rises as the working unravels and progress is lost. Once sufficient EV has been consumed (cost multiplied by the stack size), the full stack is transfigured into something new.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.dagg:
With a Tier 2 altar, you unlock a darker means of gathering [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The [#](8B0000)Dagger of Sacrifice[#](), the Dagger of Expenditure, slays any creature that wanders within two blocks of your altar, harvesting its lifeforce in a single, merciless stroke.\
\
[#](8B0000)Runes of Sacrifice[#]() amplify the yield. Different creatures surrender different quantities of essence.

Forge the Dagger of Sacrifice in the Ara Vitae ([#](B8860B)Tier 2[#](), cost: 3,000 EV).\
\
[#](2E8B57)The squeamish may wish to look away. The altar does not judge what, or whom, you feed it.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.desc: The sacred altar where blood becomes power, growing through six tiers of mastery.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.firs: Your first creation should be the [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Orb[#](), a diamond offered to a Tier 1 altar along with [#](8B0000)2,000 EV[#](). This orb is the key to your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](), the invisible network that binds your soul to all your vitaemantic instruments. Consult JEI for all recipes the Ara Vitae can perform.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.intr: Every practitioner of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() must begin here, at the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() , the Altar of Life. This sacred basin transmutes raw blood into [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), the refined lifeforce that fuels all vitaemantic works. It begins as a humble stone vessel, but do not be deceived: as your mastery deepens, the Ara Vitae grows into a towering monument of rune-carved power.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.knif:
To feed the altar, you must first forge a [#](8B0000)Sacrificial Knife[#](). By drawing the blade across your own flesh (right-click while aiming at air), you spill one heart's worth of blood into a nearby [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), yielding [#](8B0000)200 Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
The altar's basin holds [#](8B0000)10,000 EV[#]() at first. Watch the crimson pool within; its level reveals how full the vessel is. A [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() reveals the exact figures.

[#](2E8B57)Be aware:[#]() 10%% of the altar's total capacity seeps into a hidden internal reservoir, used for fluid transfer operations. If your numbers seem off, this unseen vessel is likely the cause.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.name: The Ara Vitae
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.tier: The simplest form. A lone altar, unadorned by runes.
Eight runes encircle the basin. The altar stirs with new hunger.

[#](B8860B)Tier 2[#]() demands 8 [#](8B0000)Blood Runes[#]() arranged in a ring around the altar. The four cardinal runes may be replaced with specialized variants; the corner runes remain inert until Tier 3 unlocks their potential.
28 total runes. The altar's appetite deepens.

[#](B8860B)Tier 3[#]() expands the structure outward: 5 runes along each edge, set one level down and two blocks out from the previous ring. Stone pillars rise at each corner, capped with [#](8B0000)Glowstone Blocks[#](), light to guide the essence. Use a [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() to confirm the upgrade. Any solid block suffices for the pillar bodies.
56 total runes. The structure groans with barely-contained power.

[#](B8860B)Tier 4[#]() demands 7 runes per edge, another level down and two blocks further out. Four-block pillars rise at each corner, crowned with [#](8B0000)Bloodstone Bricks[#](), for which you will need [#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#](), harvested from beyond the [#](4A0080)Edge of the Hidden Realm[#]() ritual.
108 total runes. Few Vitaemancers dare reach this height.

[#](B8860B)Tier 5[#]() calls for 13 runes per edge, three blocks out from the previous ring, with a one-block gap at each end. [#](8B0000)Hellforged Blocks[#]() anchor the corners, rare metal wrested from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() itself. The altar now commands fearsome energies.
184 total runes. The altar becomes a cathedral of blood and stone.

[#](B8860B)Tier 6[#](), the apex of the art. 19 runes per edge sprawl outward, three blocks beyond the last ring. No corner blocks at rune level; instead, pillars ascend one tier higher, crowned with [#](8B0000)Crystal Clusters[#]() that sing with resonant energy. A monument to mastery.\
\
Forge Crystal Clusters in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() from [#](8B0000)Sculk[#](), an [#](8B0000)Ethereal Slate[#](), a [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shard[#](), and a [#](8B0000)Nether Star[#](). [#](8B0000)Crystal Cluster Bricks[#]() also serve as valid capstones.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.ara_vitae.usag: Once placed, the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() awakens. It drinks the blood offered to it and distills it into [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), which it then uses to [#](4A0080)transfigure[#]() items placed within its basin. Right-click the altar to lay an item upon it; right-click with an empty hand to retrieve it.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.name: Ara Vitaes
book.neovitae.guide.altar.redstone_autom:
A comparator placed beside the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() reads the level of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within, much like a chest.\
\
Place a [#](8B0000)Bloodstone Brick[#]() beneath the altar, and the comparator instead reads the [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() of whoever owns the orb resting inside. The signal strength scales to the orb's tier, not the maximum capacity of the network.

For example, [#](8B0000)500,000 EV[#]() would register as overflowing through a Weak Blood Orb, but only half-strength through a Master Blood Orb. Clever use of this lets you shut down costly rituals before your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() runs dry.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Place a Redstone Lamp beneath the altar and it will emit a redstone pulse the instant a transmutation completes, useful for chained automation.[#]()
Mechanical servants for the Ara Vitae: hoppers, pipes, and comparators.

The altar also permits the transfer of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() to and from external tanks. Connect your fluid conduit of choice and you can stockpile excess essence for later workings.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The flow is sluggish by default. Acceleration Runes quicken the altar's pulse, while Displacement Runes widen the channel through which essence flows.[#]()

Remember: the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() piped in or out does not come directly from the altar's main basin. A hidden secondary reservoir, holding [#](8B0000)up to 10%%[#]() of the altar's total capacity, acts as the intermediary. If essence seems to vanish from the basin without explanation, or the numbers never quite add up, this phantom vessel is the culprit.

The [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() is a marvel, but even a devoted Vitaemancer tires of standing vigil over every slate. Fortunately, the altar accepts mechanical servants; items and [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() can be piped in and out, though the altar's hunger has its own peculiarities.\
\
A simple [#](8B0000)Hopper[#]() feeds items into the basin, but it knows no restraint. It will happily deposit an entire stack, and the altar will

attempt to transmute all of them at once, consuming [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() for every item in the stack. If you cannot supply that much [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() quickly enough, the working will stall and progress will bleed away.\
\
The altar also makes no distinction between input and output. Without a filter, items will cycle in and out as fast as your transfer system allows. The [#](8B0000)Routing Nodes[#]() may serve you well here.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_acceler: A rune tempered in hellfire, collapsing time twice as fast.

Tempered with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune warps time twice as aggressively, removing [#](8B0000)two ticks[#]() from the pulse delay instead of one. Fewer rune slots consumed, more room for other enchantments around the altar.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_aug_cap: A rune tempered in hellfire, multiplicatively stretching the altar's reservoir.

Wrought with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune warps the altar's capacity to staggering proportions. Each rune multiplies the total reservoir by [#](8B0000)+15%%[#](), applied after all additive expansions. At higher tiers, the difference is immense.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_capacit: A rune tempered in hellfire, vastly deepening the altar's reservoir.

Infused with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune carves a far deeper basin into the altar's soul. Each rune adds [#](8B0000)+40%%[#]() to the reservoir, additively, twice the depth of its lesser kin.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_chargin: A rune tempered in hellfire, doubling both charge rate and storage.

Hardened with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune doubles the Charging Rune's potency in every regard , both the rate at which [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is stored during idle moments and the maximum charge the rune can hold.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_disloca: A rune tempered in hellfire, vastly widening the essence flow channel.

Bolstered with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune tears the channels between altar and vessel wide open. Each rune increases the flow rate by a multiplicative [#](8B0000)+40%%[#](); essence surges rather than trickles.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_orb.des: A rune tempered in hellfire, doubling the orb's capacity expansion.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_orb.int: Augmented with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune resonates more deeply with the Blood Orb within. Each rune expands the orb's capacity by [#](8B0000)+4%%[#]() additively, twice the reach of the lesser inscription, stretching your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() further.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_orb.rev: [#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_sacrifi: A rune tempered in hellfire, doubling the harvest from slain creatures.

Tempered with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), the reinforced rune wrings twice the essence from every offering, [#](8B0000)+20%%[#]() per rune, additively. The altar's appetite for sacrifice grows ever more insatiable.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_self_sa: A rune tempered in hellfire, doubling the yield of your own spilled blood.

Strengthened with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune doubles the reward for your own blood, [#](8B0000)+20%%[#]() per rune, additively. Each wound you inflict upon yourself yields twice the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() of the lesser inscription.
[#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_speed.d: A rune tempered in hellfire, doubling the altar's haste.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_speed.i: Forged with [#](8B0000)Netherite Scrap[#]() and [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#]() plundered from the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), this rune doubles the tempo of its lesser counterpart. The altar's transmutations quicken by [#](8B0000)+40%%[#]() per rune, additively; the basin practically hums with impatience.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_2_speed.r: [#](2E8B57)Should you have need of the base rune again, the Athanor can strip the reinforcement and return it to its original form.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_accelerat: Collapses the interval between Charging and Displacement pulses.

The [#](8B0000)Acceleration Rune[#]() collapses time around certain altar operations. The [#](8B0000)Charging Rune[#]() and [#](8B0000)Displacement Rune[#]() normally pulse once every 20 ticks; each Acceleration Rune shaves one tick from that delay, down to a minimum of a single tick between pulses. The altar's secondary rhythms become a frantic heartbeat.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_aug_capac: Multiplicatively expands the altar's reservoir beyond what additive runes can achieve.

Where the standard [#](8B0000)Rune of Capacity[#]() widens the basin, the [#](8B0000)Rune of Augmented Capacity[#]() reshapes the altar's very nature. Each rune multiplies the total reservoir by [#](8B0000)+7.5%%[#](), applied after all additive Capacity Runes have taken effect. The difference between the two is subtle at first, but devastating at scale.
Deepens the altar's reservoir to hold more Essentia Vitae.

The [#](8B0000)Rune of Capacity[#]() deepens the altar's basin, allowing the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to hold more [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() before overflowing. Each rune expands the reservoir by [#](8B0000)+20%%[#](), stacking additively. A deeper well means fewer interruptions during costly transmutations.
Stores Essentia Vitae during idle moments for instant transmutation.

The altar pulses once every 20 ticks, reduced by 1 per [#](8B0000)Acceleration Rune[#]().\
\
Each pulse stores: [[#](8B0000)10 EV[#]() x [#](8B0000)Charging Runes[#]() x (1 + [#](8B0000)Speed Runes[#]()/10)]\
\
Maximum stored charge: [#](8B0000)1,000 EV[#]() per [#](8B0000)Charging Rune[#](), multiplied by [altar capacity / 20,000] if that ratio exceeds 1.

The [#](8B0000)Charging Rune[#]() inscribes a pattern of [#](4A0080)anticipation[#]() into the altar. When the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() lies idle, neither crafting nor filling a Blood Orb, it siphons [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into a hidden reserve within the rune itself. The moment an item is placed upon the altar, this stored charge floods into the transmutation instantly, at a perfect 1:1 ratio.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_dislocati: Widens the flow of Essentia Vitae to and from external vessels.

The [#](8B0000)Displacement Rune[#]() widens the unseen channels through which [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() flows between the altar and external vessels. Each rune increases the fluid transfer rate by a multiplicative [#](8B0000)+20%%[#](). Essential for any Vitaemancer who stores essence in outside tanks.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_orb.descr: Stretches the Blood Orb's capacity while it rests in the altar.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_orb.intro: The [#](8B0000)Rune of the Orb[#]() resonates with the [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() resting within the altar, stretching the boundaries of your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](). While the orb sits in the basin, each rune increases its capacity by [#](8B0000)+2%%[#]() additively. The orb must remain within the altar to benefit; remove it, and the expansion fades.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_orb.name: Rune of the Orb
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_sacrifice: Amplifies the Essentia Vitae harvested from sacrificed creatures.

The [#](8B0000)Rune of Sacrifice[#]() deepens the altar's thirst for the blood of others. When a creature is slain upon the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), by the [#](8B0000)Dagger of Sacrifice[#]() or similar means, each rune amplifies the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() harvested by [#](8B0000)+10%%[#](), stacking additively. The altar remembers every offering.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_self_sacr: Rewards your own pain with greater Essentia Vitae from self-inflicted wounds.

The [#](8B0000)Rune of Self-Sacrifice[#]() honors the practitioner who spills their own blood for the art. Each rune carved into the altar's ring increases the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() yielded from your own wounds by [#](8B0000)+10%%[#](), stacking additively. The Sacrificial Knife and similar self-harming instruments all benefit from this rune's blessing.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_speed.des: Hastens the altar's transmutations, for those who cannot abide waiting.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.rune_speed.int: The [#](8B0000)Speed Rune[#]() quickens the altar's heartbeat. Every transmutation the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() performs, the consumption of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), the slow reshaping of matter, accelerates by [#](8B0000)+20%%[#]() per rune, stacking additively. Be warned: an empty altar also loses progress faster with these runes in place.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.blank_r:
[#](B8860B)Blank Slate[#](): Lay smooth stone upon a [#](B8860B)Tier 1[#]() altar. The basin drinks [#](8B0000)1,000 EV[#]() and etches the first sigils into the stone.\
\
[#](B8860B)Reinforced Slate[#](): Feed a Blank Slate to a [#](B8860B)Tier 2[#]() altar. Cost: [#](8B0000)2,000 EV[#](). The sigils deepen, the stone hardens with purpose.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.descrip: Inscribed stone tablets forged in the Ara Vitae, each tier more potent than the last.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.etherea: [#](B8860B)Ethereal Slate[#](): A Demonic Slate surrendered to a [#](B8860B)Tier 5[#]() altar. Cost: [#](8B0000)30,000 EV[#](). The slate becomes almost translucent, hovering at the edge between the material and the [#](4A0080)beyond[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.imbued_:
[#](B8860B)Imbued Slate[#](): A Reinforced Slate offered to a [#](B8860B)Tier 3[#]() altar. Cost: [#](8B0000)5,000 EV[#](). The stone now pulses with a faint, living warmth.\
\
[#](B8860B)Demonic Slate[#](): An Imbued Slate consumed by a [#](B8860B)Tier 4[#]() altar. Cost: [#](8B0000)15,000 EV[#](). Dark veins thread through the tablet like frozen lightning.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.intro.t: The [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() does more than fill orbs; it is a crucible for forging [#](8B0000)Slates[#](), the inscribed stone tablets that serve as the foundation for nearly every vitaemantic creation. Each successive tier of slate demands a more powerful altar and a steeper offering of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.altar.slates.name: The Slates
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demon_stone: The pale foundation of a realm not meant for mortal eyes.

The [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() is built from a pale-blue material unknown to our world, a substance practitioners have taken to calling [#](8B0000)Demon Stone[#](). Its creation is deceptively simple: an infusion of ordinary stone with a measure of [#](4A0080)Will[#](). Yet the result is something fundamentally alien.

A troubling property of this material: it is [#](4A0080)aggressively transmutative[#](). Any attempt to combine Demon Stone with ordinary stone simply yields more Demon Stone, as though the material hungers to convert all it touches. Consult JEI for the spread recipes.
Consult JEI for the Demon Stone recipe.

Introducing stone to [#](4A0080)Corrosive[#](), [#](4A0080)Destructive[#](), [#](4A0080)Steadfast[#](), or [#](4A0080)Vengeful[#]() Will produces coloured variants of Demon Stone, each carrying the faintest resonance of its aspect. All variants can be shaped in a stonecutter into various decorative patterns. Consult JEI for variant and spread recipes.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demonite.at: [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#]() can be produced within the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() from gravel, ore, or raw demonite. This powdered form is essential for advanced potion-craft.
The [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() can further process demonite into fragments and gravel, offering multiple avenues to extract value from each piece of ore you wrest from the mines.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demonite.de: Hellforged Blocks can be shaped in a [#](8B0000)stonecutter[#]() into variants faintly tainted with [#](4A0080)Corrosive[#](), [#](4A0080)Destructive[#](), [#](4A0080)Steadfast[#](), or [#](4A0080)Vengeful[#]() Will. Each decorative variant can be deconstructed back into 9 [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#]().
A dark ore found only in the deepest tunnels of the Demon Realm.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demonite.he: Consult JEI for the Raw Hellforged Block recipe.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demonite.in:
[#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() exists only within [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() of the Endless Realm, accessible after locating a [#](8B0000)Foreman's Key[#]() and unsealing the [#](4A0080)Spatial Distortion[#]() that guards the passage. This ore yields [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#]() or [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#]() through various processing methods.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A Silk Touch enchantment harvests the ore block itself. Without it, you receive clumps of Raw Demonite.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.demonite.sm: Both the raw ore and its mined clumps can be smelted into [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#](), the refined essence of demonic metallurgy. Consult JEI for these smelting recipes.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.dungeon_alt: A tireless redstone pulse, born of demonic clockwork.

The [#](8B0000)Dungeon Alternator[#]() pulses with a ceaseless rhythm, emitting a redstone signal that oscillates between powered and dormant states at fixed intervals. It is the heartbeat of the realm's trap mechanisms, a [#](4A0080)demonic clockwork[#]() device of elegant simplicity.\
\
[#](2E8B57)These can be repurposed as compact redstone clocks in your own constructions. Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.dungeon_eye: Luminous sentinels embedded in the walls of the Demon Realm.

Set into the walls of the [#](4A0080)Endless Realm[#](), the [#](8B0000)Dungeon Eye[#]() emits a pale, unwavering light. Whether these serve as sentinels or mere decoration is unclear; what is certain is that they illuminate the darkness with no fuel or flame.\
\
Variants exist tinted by [#](4A0080)Raw[#](), [#](4A0080)Corrosive[#](), [#](4A0080)Destructive[#](), [#](4A0080)Steadfast[#](), and [#](4A0080)Vengeful[#]() Will. Consult JEI for crafting recipes.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.endless_rea: The heart of the Demon Realm, where darkness breeds treasure and peril in equal measure.

[#](4A0080)Spatial Distortions[#]() are fractures in the architecture of the realm itself. A whispered message will alert you when you have entered a room harboring one. These anomalies conceal either the entrance to [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() or a sealed chamber containing the [#](8B0000)Foreman's Key[#](), the latter opened with an [#](8B0000)Iron Key[#](). The mine entrance always manifests before the key chamber, so be prepared to retrace your steps.
An Iron Key will unseal this chamber. Within lies the Foreman's Key, coveted prize of the deep.

Delve deep enough and fortune may smile upon you with [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#](). These rare components can be used to [#](4A0080)double the potency[#]() of your existing [#](8B0000)Runes[#](), effectively granting the power of two Ara Vitaes in a single structure.

Where the Antechamber merely grazes the surface of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), the [#](8B0000)Pathway to the Endless Realm[#]() ritual tears the veil wide open. You emerge before another [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](), but the air here is thicker, the shadows deeper. A lone chest awaits, left by some prior explorer who did not leave by choice, and doorways branch outward into the labyrinth beyond.

A second [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#]() stands ready to return you home. Use it wisely; the creatures that dwell here are far more formidable than those of the Antechamber, and the rewards they guard are proportionally greater.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Watch for messages warning of [#](8B0000)Spatial Distortions[#]() as you explore, and keep any [#](8B0000)Foreman's Keys[#]() you discover close at hand.[#]()
Only the Foreman's Key will open this passage. If you have not yet found it, you must venture back.

Beyond the sealed passage lie [#](8B0000)The Mines[#](), a [#](B8860B)significant escalation[#]() in both peril and plunder. Veins of [#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() thread through the walls here, essential for advanced potion-craft and the construction of the [#](B8860B)Tier-5 Ara Vitae[#]() and its accompanying Orb. Alongside the ore, you will find enchanted armaments, anointments, potions, and other spoils worthy of the risk.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.descri: The means by which the sealed corridors of the Demon Realm are opened.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.distor: As you delve deeper, you may encounter [#](4A0080)Spatial Distortions[#](), anomalies that conceal either a unique, uncraftable key or a door that only such a key can open. These fractures manifest only within the Endless Realm proper; you will never find one in the Antechamber.
The [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() does not yield its secrets freely. Passage through its sealed corridors demands [#](8B0000)Keys[#](), forged or found. The simplest variety, [#](8B0000)Iron Keys[#](), can be discovered in the [#](8B0000)Antechamber[#]() chests or scattered throughout the nearer chambers of the Endless Realm. They can also be forged by your own hand.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.iron_k: Iron Keys can be forged in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](). One wonders why the demons never thought to simply pick the locks.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.miners: Miner's Keys can be forged in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](). The mines await, practitioner. Steel your nerves.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.mines_: The passage to [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() can only be breached with the [#](8B0000)Foreman's Key[#](), a relic that cannot be crafted and must be found. Beyond that threshold, [#](8B0000)Miner's Keys[#]() open the remaining sealed doors. The mines offer [#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() and rare plunder, though the dangers there are commensurate with the rewards.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.keys.name: Dungeon Keys
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.lobby.descr: The threshold between worlds, where the Demon Realm first reveals itself.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.lobby.intro:
When the [#](8B0000)Edge of the Hidden Realm[#]() ritual completes, you will find yourself standing before an [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](). Touch it, and you are drawn across the threshold into the [#](4A0080)Antechamber[#](), the outermost vestibule of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]().\
\
Take stock of your surroundings:

- A solitary chest, sometimes containing [#](8B0000)Iron Keys[#]().

- Several [#](8B0000)Doorways[#](), each barred by a [#](8B0000)Dungeon Seal[#](). Present a key to a seal to unseal the chamber beyond.

- A second [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](), mirroring the one that summoned you. This is your lifeline home.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The stonework here is unique to the Demon Realm. If its aesthetics appeal to you, help yourself.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.lobby.name: The Antechamber
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.lobby.rooms:
Each sealed chamber you open may contain treasure, hostile denizens, traps, or dormant rituals. Vigilance is the price of survival here.\
\
Among the spoils you may claim:

- Enchanted Books

- Enchanted Weapons and Armour

- Various Anointments

- Spiritus

- Potion Ingredients

- Tau Fruit

- Saturated Tau

- Tau Oil\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Antechamber is merely a foretaste. Prove yourself here, and the deeper reaches of the realm will open to you in time.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.mimics.desc: Phantom blocks that wear the faces of others.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.mimics.intr:
[#](8B0000)Ethereal Mimics[#]() are blocks of a curious [#](4A0080)liminal[#]() nature. They adopt the appearance of any block presented to them, yet remain completely intangible, as though they exist only partially in our reality. This makes them ideal for concealing pitfall traps, hidden passages, and secret chambers.\
\
You may encounter them within the [#](8B0000)Endless Realm[#](), where they were clearly put to devious use.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.mimics.name: Ethereal Mimics
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.mimics.reci:
[#](2E8B57)Right-click a placed Ethereal Mimic with any block to assign it that block's appearance. It will look solid to the eye but offer no resistance to passage.[#]()\
\
Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.name: Dungeon Delving
Dormant blades that awaken at a redstone whisper.

[#](8B0000)Spike Traps[#]() sit dormant and deceptively innocuous until a redstone signal reaches them, whereupon serrated blades erupt from their housing with lethal intent. Whatever [#](4A0080)intelligence[#]() designed these was clearly determined to discourage uninvited guests.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Clever practitioners have repurposed these for their own defenses. Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.tau_fruit.d: A parasitic fruit of the Demon Realm, nourished by the living.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.tau_fruit.i:
[#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#]() is first encountered growing wild in the [#](4A0080)Simple Dungeons[#]() of the Demon Realm. Once harvested, it can be cultivated, though as a native growth of that accursed place, its lifecycle is far more demanding than any mundane crop.\
\
Left to mature under ordinary conditions, it ripens into common [#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#](), which can be refined into [#](8B0000)Tau Oil[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.tau_fruit.s: There exists a darker method of cultivation. If a [#](4A0080)living creature[#]() stands atop the plant as it matures, the Tau vine will draw upon the creature's vitality to feed its own growth. The result is [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#](), a far more potent variant born from stolen life.
book.neovitae.guide.dungeons.tau_fruit.t: [#](8B0000)Tau Oil[#]() is rendered from its fruit upon the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](). It carries a scent reminiscent of blood oranges, though with an unmistakable undertone of something decidedly otherworldly.

Tau Oil serves two principal purposes in Vitaemancy:

- It extends the duration of any [#](8B0000)anointment[#]() by a factor of four.

- It is a key ingredient in [#](8B0000)Intermediate Cutting Fluid[#](), which functions like its basic counterpart but endures eight times longer and provides a 25%% speed boost.
book.neovitae.guide.name: Scriptura Vitae
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.activation_c: The [#](8B0000)Awakened Activation Crystal[#]() resonates with deeper currents of power, required to activate [#](B8860B)advanced rituals[#]() beyond the Weak Crystal's reach. It is forged within the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() from its lesser counterpart.
The spark that awakens sleeping runes.

A properly inscribed circle is inert without the spark of will to awaken it. The [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#]() serves as that spark, a focus through which you open a conduit between your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() and the waiting runes, breathing purpose into stone.

The [#](8B0000)Weak Activation Crystal[#]() is forged within the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() from a [#](8B0000)Lava Crystal[#](). Press Use with a bound crystal upon the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() to ignite the circle.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.name: Rituals
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_anima: Hastens the maturation of young creatures.

The circle radiates a warm vitality that seeps into the bones of young creatures, hastening their maturation. Baby animals within its influence grow to adulthood at an accelerated rate, as though seasons passed in mere moments.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Further accelerates the growth of young creatures.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Compels adult animals to breed without intervention.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Increases the frequency of growth pulses.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Collects products from sheared or milked animals into a nearby chest.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_armou: Evolves Living Armor beyond its former limits.

Stand upon the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() while clad in [#](8B0000)Living Armor[#](), and the circle will pour its power into the symbiotic plates. The armor evolves; its capacity for upgrades deepens, its potential expands. This is the crucible through which your armor transcends its former limits.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_basic:
Remember that some rituals extend several blocks above and below the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). If nothing happens at all, ensure the crystal is bound to an [#](4A0080)Anima[#](); press Use while holding it to bind it to yours.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A crystal need not be bound to your own Anima. If you acquire another Vitaemancer's crystal, you can activate rituals using their EV. Guard yours well.[#]()

Place a [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), then hold Use with the Diviner aimed at it until every stone has been placed and inscribed with the correct element.\
\
Finally, press Use on the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() with your [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#]() in hand. If the circle is complete, you will feel a rush of energy; the ritual awakens.
Inscribing circles of power upon the world.

When your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() reaches [#](B8860B)Tier 3[#](), the boundaries of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() expand dramatically. You gain access to [#](4A0080)Rituals[#](), vast sigil-circles that channel your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() into sustained, powerful effects upon the world itself.\
\
To perform a ritual, you require:

- An [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#](). At [#](B8860B)Tier 3[#](), only the [#](8B0000)Weak Crystal[#]() is available.

- A [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Every ritual demands exactly one at its heart.

One final note: all rituals respond to a [#](8B0000)redstone[#]() signal. A lever on the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() provides a simple means of silencing it. Combine this with redstone automation to ensure your rituals shut down before your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() runs dry.

- Sufficient [#](8B0000)Ritual Stones[#]() to form the pattern.

- A [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]() (strongly recommended). While not strictly necessary, it simplifies construction immensely.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Press Sneak + Use with the Diviner in hand to cycle through available rituals. Check rune requirements by hovering over it in your inventory while sneaking.[#]()

If instead you feel a push but are too weak, your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() lacks the [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() needed for activation. Fill your reserves and try again.\
\
If the runes feel misconfigured, something obstructs or misaligns the pattern. Clear the area of blockages and reassemble the circle with care.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_condo: Bestows true flight upon all within the circle.

The circle bestows the gift of true flight upon all practitioners within its reach, not the crude hop of enchanted boots, but the unfettered freedom of a soaring bird. You may fly as freely as though gravity itself has been revoked.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The flight range can be configured with the Ritual Tinkerer.[#]()
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_conta: Imprisons creatures within an invisible barrier.

An unseen barrier of [#](4A0080)vitaemantic force[#]() encircles the ritual, preventing any creature from escaping its boundaries. Those that try are pushed inexorably back toward the center. Practitioners pass through freely, making this ideal for penning livestock or trapping hostile entities for your purposes.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_craft:
You must define the recipe using an [#](8B0000)Item Filter[#](). The ritual accepts only one filter at a time. The following types are recognized:

- [#](8B0000)Standard Item Filter[#](): Specifies exact items for each slot.

- [#](8B0000)Tag Item Filter[#](): Uses item tags to define valid ingredients.

- [#](8B0000)Mod Item Filter[#](): Accepts any item from the specified source.

A versatile and powerful ritual, the [#](8B0000)Rhythm of the Beating Anvil[#]() automates crafting, standard recipes by default, or [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() and [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() recipes with the proper augmentation. Its configuration is more involved than most, so study the following pages carefully.\
\
Each ritual handles exactly one recipe at a time.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

Place the filter in an [#](8B0000)Item Frame[#]() on the ritual structure, or inside the linked chest. If multiple filters exist in the chest, only the first is used.\
\
[#](2E8B57)By default, input and output share the same chest. Use the Ritual Tinkerer to separate them.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Redirects crafting to a linked [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]().

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Redirects crafting to a linked [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)All recipes are treated as shapeless. If two of the same item are needed, specify it twice in the filter.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_crush: Grinds blocks to dust and collects the spoils.

This ritual exerts an invisible, crushing force upon the blocks within its domain, reducing them to their component drops and depositing the results into a nearby chest. A methodical, relentless destroyer.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Increases the number of blocks shattered per tick.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Applies [#](8B0000)Silk Touch[#]() to broken blocks. Requires [#](8B0000)Cutting Fluid[#]() in the input chest.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Compresses drops; coal becomes blocks, dust becomes ingots.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Applies [#](8B0000)Fortune III[#]() to all broken blocks.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Applies both [#](8B0000)Silk Touch[#]() and [#](8B0000)Fortune[#]() simultaneously, a potent combination.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_cryst: Distills forsaken essence into will catalysts.

When creatures perish within this ritual's domain, their departing essence is intercepted, not the vital spark, but the lingering [#](4A0080)demonic residue[#]() that clings to all mortal things. The circle distills this into [#](8B0000)Spiritus Catalysts[#](), potent reagents for cultivating and enhancing will crystals. The resulting catalysts are deposited into a nearby chest.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
Reaps crystallized will from mature clusters.

This ritual carefully shears excess spires from [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal Clusters[#]() within its reach, collecting the harvested shards. It works with all [#](4A0080)aspects[#]() of will, raw, corrosive, destructive, vengeful, and steadfast alike.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
Fractures raw Spiritus into its aspected components.

This ritual shatters a mature [#](8B0000)Raw Crystal Cluster[#]() (at least 5 spires) positioned 2 blocks above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), refining it into individual spires of each [#](8B0000)Aspected Will[#]() Crystal Cluster. These new crystals appear above the four elemental [#](8B0000)Ritual Stones[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

The spacing is designed to accommodate a [#](8B0000)Crystallarium Maleficum[#]() atop the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)For details on cultivating Spiritus Crystals, consult the Crystallized Will entry in the Spiritus chapter.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_divin:
The Diviner can clear soft obstructions like tall grass and snow, but not solid blocks. Ensure the area is unobstructed before you begin, or the [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#]() will find the circle incomplete.\
\
The base Diviner can only inscribe simpler rituals. For the most advanced patterns, you must upgrade it with [#](8B0000)Dusk Inscription Tools[#]().
Tap Use while aiming at a [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() and the Diviner will construct the selected ritual, consuming [#](8B0000)Ritual Stones[#]() from your inventory as it works.
The architect's wand for inscribing ritual circles.

You can also change the facing of the completed ritual by pressing Use in the air. This only matters for asymmetrical rituals such as the [#](8B0000)Ritual of Speed[#](); most patterns are perfectly symmetrical.
Unlike the [#](8B0000)Elemental Inscription Tools[#](), the Ritual Diviner and its [#](B8860B)Dusk[#]() variant are inexhaustible; they will never wear out.

The base Diviner requires one of each [#](8B0000)Elemental Inscription Tool[#](), and thus a [#](B8860B)Tier 3[#]() [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
The four elemental tools each cost [#](8B0000)1,000 EV[#]() to craft. The [#](B8860B)Dusk[#]() variant requires a [#](B8860B)Tier 4[#]() Altar and two [#](8B0000)Dusk Inscription Tools[#]() at [#](8B0000)2,000 EV[#]() each.\
\
While the Diviner handles functional ritual construction, the inscription tools remain useful for [#](2E8B57)decorative purposes[#](). Use them to paint ritual markings onto stones by hand for aesthetic ritual circles, thematic builds, or simply to mark areas of importance. They never break, so use them freely.

Ritual circles demand precision; you cannot simply scatter inscriptions at random and expect the currents of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() to flow correctly. The [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]() is the master architect's tool, a wand that knows every pattern by heart.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Hold Sneak and press Use or Attack while looking at empty air to cycle through available rituals in either direction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_ellip: Constructs perfect geometric forms from raw materials.

A ritual for the blood mage who appreciates elegant geometry. This circle draws blocks from a nearby chest and arranges them into a perfect ellipsoidal form, domes, arches, vaults, and other shapes that would take a mortal builder considerable time to calculate by hand.\
\
Every practitioner needs a proper sanctum. This ritual helps you build one worthy of the art.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_expul: Drives all creatures from your sanctum.

Where the Ritual of Binding imprisons, this circle repels. A wave of [#](4A0080)vitaemantic force[#]() radiates outward from the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), driving all creatures beyond its boundaries. Practitioners remain unaffected, allowing you to ward your sanctum against uninvited guests.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_feath: Converts the practitioner's own vitality into EV.

Where the Well of Suffering takes from unwilling victims, this ritual draws from the practitioner's own vitality, a more honorable, if painful, path. It drains health from nearby blood mages and converts it into [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#](), depositing the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into a nearby [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](). Efficiency improves with [#](8B0000)Runes of Self Sacrifice[#]() and the [#](8B0000)Tough Palms[#]() upgrade.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Increases the [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() gained per health sacrificed.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Channels the [#](8B0000)Incense Bonus[#]() from a nearby [#](8B0000)Incense Altar[#]().

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): When paired with [#](8B0000)Steadfast[#](), increases the drain rate.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Raises the maximum vitality drained per tick.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Prevents the ritual from draining you to death.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_felli: An unseen force that fells every tree in its domain.

An invisible lumberjack stalks the ritual's domain, felling every tree it finds; logs shatter, leaves scatter, and the timber is gathered into a nearby chest if one is available. Pair this with a grove ritual and saplings for an endless supply of wood.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_full_: Feeds all practitioners from a nearby larder.

This ritual draws sustenance from a nearby chest and feeds it to every practitioner within its reach, restoring hunger and saturation without pause. A blood mage who never hungers is one who never falters; keep the larder stocked, and the circle will handle the rest.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_geode: Communes with geodes to cultivate and reap crystals.

This ritual resonates with amethyst geodes, coaxing their crystals to grow at an accelerated pace and harvesting the mature clusters when they ripen. A patient circle that rewards the practitioner with a steady supply of precious shards.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Hastens crystal growth.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Enables automatic harvest of mature clusters.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Lashes out at nearby creatures.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Applies a Fortune effect to harvested clusters.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Deposits harvested shards into a nearby chest.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_green: Suffuses the earth with life, hastening all growth.

Blood is the wellspring of all life, and this ritual proves it. The circle suffuses the surrounding soil with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), accelerating the growth of crops and plants within its reach as though seasons passed in moments.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Hastens the growth rate further.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Hydrates nearby farmland, ensuring fertile soil.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Causes nearby plants to spread and propagate.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Intensifies the effect at higher will concentrations.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Coaxes nearby saplings into full-grown trees.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_groun: Denies the sky to all within its domain.

This circle enforces a cruel gravity upon all within its domain. Wings fail. Enchantments falter. Any entity that dares take flight is dragged back to the earth, as though the world itself refuses to release them.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Strengthens the grounding effect.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Applies the [#](8B0000)Suspended[#]() effect, halting vertical movement entirely.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Inflicts [#](8B0000)Levitation[#](), a cruel irony, dragging entities skyward against their will.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Applies the [#](8B0000)Heavy Heart[#]() affliction.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Expands the area of influence.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_harve: Reaps and replants mature crops with an unseen sickle.

This ritual commands an unseen sickle across your fields, harvesting mature crops and replanting them in a single sweep. The bounty falls to the ground near where it grew, awaiting collection. Combined with the [#](8B0000)Ritual of the Green Grove[#](), you have the makings of a self-sustaining farm.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
Grants practitioners the power to leap skyward.

The circle lightens the very bones of those who stand within it, granting a powerful upward surge to every leap. Practitioners bound skyward with ease, clearing obstacles that would otherwise demand ladders or scaffolding.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
Tears open a seam to the molten depths.

This ritual tears open a seam to the molten depths, conjuring lava source blocks above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). The heat it radiates is palpable; handle with the respect due to the Nether's own blood.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Channels lava directly into a tank placed above the ritual, reducing [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() cost.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Sets nearby hostile creatures ablaze.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Marks hostile mobs with [#](8B0000)Fire Fuse[#](). When it expires, they detonate spectacularly.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Accelerates the rate of lava conjuration.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Wraps nearby practitioners in [#](8B0000)Fire Resistance[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_livin:
Each matching key item increases that downgrade by one level. Multiple downgrades can be applied at once; for example, Battle Hungry III requires 3 [#](8B0000)Rotten Flesh[#]() and items worth 35 [#](8B0000)Upgrade Points[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)The ritual respects your Training Bracelet settings. Excess points are returned as Upgrade Scraps.[#]()
