Downgrades are harsh; they cripple specific abilities in exchange for a wealth of additional [#](8B0000)Upgrade Points[#](). This is the path of [#](4A0080)specialization[#](): sacrifice breadth to sharpen your edge in the areas that matter most.

This ritual consumes [#](8B0000)Upgrade Points[#]() (from [#](8B0000)Tomes[#](), [#](8B0000)Scraps[#](), or [#](8B0000)Synthetic Points[#]()) alongside a specific [#](8B0000)Key Item[#]() per level, inscribing [#](4A0080)Downgrades[#]() into your worn [#](8B0000)Living Armor[#](). Each downgrade demands a different key item.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
If you lack sufficient points, you can craft [#](8B0000)Synthetic Upgrade Points[#](). Each is worth a single point, crude, but functional.

Place your point sources and the required key items into the linked chest while wearing your [#](8B0000)Living Armor[#](). The ritual consumes them in order: [#](8B0000)Upgrade Scraps[#]() first, then [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tomes[#](), and finally [#](8B0000)Synthetic Points[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_magne: Summons ores from the deep earth to the surface.

This ritual reaches deep beneath the earth, calling ores upward from the stone to the surface. By default it searches a 3-block radius down to bedrock. Place a precious block beneath the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() to widen its grasp:

- [#](8B0000)Block of Iron[#](): 7 blocks.

- [#](8B0000)Block of Gold[#](): 15 blocks.

- [#](8B0000)Block of Diamond[#](): 31 blocks.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_meteo: Tears a celestial body from the void above.

With enough [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() and ambition, you can tear a celestial body from the void above and hurl it earthward. Drop a suitable offering atop the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](); the ritual consumes it along with an enormous expenditure of [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#](), then calls down a meteor from the sky. When it strikes, it detonates, leaving a crater rich with resources to mine and process.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

The composition and scale of the meteor vary with the offering. Standard offerings include [#](8B0000)Diamond[#](), [#](8B0000)Block of Iron[#](), [#](8B0000)Glowstone Dust[#](), and [#](8B0000)Stone[#]().\
\
Exotic offerings from other disciplines are also recognized: [#](8B0000)Dragon Bones[#](), [#](8B0000)Certus Quartz[#](), [#](8B0000)Andesite Alloy[#](), [#](8B0000)Copper Wire Coil[#](), [#](8B0000)Prosperity Shard[#](), [#](8B0000)RF Coil[#](), and [#](8B0000)Advanced Alloy[#](), among others.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_phant: Weaves spectral platforms beneath your feet.

This ritual weaves [#](4A0080)phantom matter[#]() beneath the feet of any practitioner within its reach, translucent platforms that solidify only when stepped upon, allowing passage across chasms and voids.\
\
When the ritual falls silent, the phantom bridges dissolve like morning mist. Invaluable for traversing dangerous terrain or constructing in treacherous places.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_place: Fills the void with blocks drawn from a chest.

This ritual draws blocks from a nearby chest and places them into empty spaces within its domain, filling voids, building foundations, and shaping terrain with tireless precision. Where the [#](8B0000)Yawning of the Void[#]() devours, this circle creates.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
Draws surrounding fluids into a waiting vessel.

This ritual draws fluid source blocks from the surrounding terrain and channels them into a tank placed directly above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Water, lava, or stranger liquids; it drinks them all with equal thirst. Each source block extracted costs [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_regen: Mends the wounds of all within its reach.

This ritual suffuses the area with restorative energy, mending the wounds of all living entities within reach at the cost of [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() from the activator's [#](4A0080)Anima[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Enables a vampiric mode; hostile creatures are drained of vitality, and their stolen life force is used to heal nearby practitioners.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_simpl: Tears a narrow fissure into the Demon Realm.

This ritual tears a narrow fissure in the fabric of reality, opening a gateway to the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), a treacherous dimension teeming with hostile entities and coveted resources. This lesser portal provides an introductory trial for those who dare to test their strength against what lurks beyond.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_speed: The circle hums with kinetic potential, infusing all practitioners within its reach with unnatural swiftness. Your blood runs hot and your limbs move as though unburdened by mortal weight.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Heightens the swiftness granted.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Afflicts hostile creatures with Slowness.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Bestows Haste upon practitioners.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): Amplifies the effect at higher will concentrations.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Grants resistance to knockback.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_spher: Conjures a hollow sphere of spectral matter.

This ritual conjures a hollow sphere of [#](4A0080)phantom matter[#]() centered above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), a translucent shell that hangs in the air like a captured moon. The sphere's radius can be adjusted with the [#](8B0000)Ritual Tinkerer[#](), though the [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() cost scales accordingly.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_stand: Rends the veil wide into the Demon Realm's depths.

This ritual rends the veil wide, opening a full passage into the depths of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](). What awaits is not a trial; it is a war. The creatures within are far more dangerous than those encountered through the lesser gateway. Arm yourself well, apprentice. Many who step through do not return.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_stone: The foundation of every ritual circle.

[#](8B0000)Ritual Stones[#]() are the foundation upon which every [#](4A0080)ritual circle[#]() is inscribed. Each stone serves as a vessel for elemental resonance, channeling the forces that give your rituals form.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Elemental Inscription Tools[#]() can be used to paint stones by hand; they never break, so feel free to use them for decoration as well as function.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_suppr: Holds all fluids at bay within a warded dome.

This ritual projects a hemispherical ward that holds all fluids at bay; water, lava, and stranger liquids alike are temporarily suppressed, not destroyed. When the circle falls silent, the tide returns as though nothing happened.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Invaluable for underwater construction, draining lava lakes, or carving safe pockets in flooded depths.[#]()
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_tinke:
- [#](8B0000)Define Area[#](): Specifies the zone in which the ritual operates, and displays the current boundaries. If multiple zones exist, pressing Sneak and Use on the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() cycles between them.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Some rituals can be expanded far beyond their default range, but the EV cost scales to match. Tread carefully with your reserves.[#]()
Fine-tune the reach and resonance of your circles.

The [#](8B0000)Ritual Tinkerer[#]() is an essential instrument for the practitioner who demands mastery over their [#](4A0080)ritual circles[#](). It offers three modes of interaction, each granting deeper control. Cycle between them by pressing Sneak and Use.

- [#](8B0000)Information[#](): Reveals the purpose of the selected [#](4A0080)ritual[#](), much like the [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]().

- [#](8B0000)Set Will Consumed[#](): Attunes the ritual to consume specific types of [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the [#](4A0080)Aura[#](). Carry the desired [#](8B0000)Will Crystals[#]() in your hotbar, one for each aspect you wish the ritual to draw upon. The effects of each will type are detailed on individual ritual pages.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_upgra: Excises upgrades from Living Armor as reusable tomes.

This ritual carefully excises upgrades from your [#](8B0000)Living Armor[#](), crystallizing the extracted knowledge into [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tomes[#]() that can be reapplied later. Nothing is truly lost, only rearranged. Use this when you wish to reshape your armor's capabilities for a new purpose.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_water: Conjures water from the aether itself.

Among the first rituals a young Vitaemancer learns, this circle conjures water from nothing, placing source blocks above the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Though humble in its purpose, a spring that never runs dry is a gift not to be underestimated.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_well_: Harvests Essentia Vitae from the suffering of others.
[#](2E8B57)The ritual links to only one altar at a time. Slain creatures still yield their normal non-player-kill drops.[#]()

Perhaps the most infamous ritual in all of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](). The circle inflicts suffering upon every creature within its reach, siphoning [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from their agony and channeling it into a nearby [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](). Place a [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() in the altar and line its walls with [#](8B0000)Runes of Sacrifice[#](); provided you can supply enough victims, your reserves will never run dry.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_yawni: Devours the earth, layer by insatiable layer.
This ritual opens an insatiable hunger in the earth, consuming blocks layer by layer and collecting their drops, a quarry driven not by pistons and gears, but by [#](4A0080)vitaemantic will[#]().
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Accelerates the excavation rate.\
\
- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Enables block filtering. Place an [#](8B0000)Item Filter[#]() in the linked chest to restrict what is mined. Standard, Tag, Mod, and Composite filters are all accepted. Blacklisting works as well.\
\
- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Rather than destroying blocks, relocates them above the ritual, creating a surface copy of the excavated terrain.
book.neovitae.guide.rituals.ritual_zephy: A persistent wind that gathers all loose items.

A gentle but persistent wind sweeps through the ritual's domain, gathering every loose item it finds and carrying them into a nearby chest. No dropped treasure escapes its notice, an invaluable companion to mob farms, tree felling rituals, or any operation that scatters its bounty across the ground.
[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aspected_wi:
The ritual fractures raw Will into four distinct [#](4A0080)Aspects[#]():

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): upon the Water Rune

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): upon the Air Rune

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): upon the Fire Rune

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): upon the Earth Rune\
\
Each Aspect can be burned in the [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() just as Raw Spiritus can, feeding the [#](8B0000)Aura[#]() with its particular resonance for your Rituals to draw upon.
Fracturing raw Spiritus into four elemental temperaments.

To fill a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() with a specific Aspect, place an empty gem into a [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() situated in the same chunk as a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#](). Feed the Vas Maleficum with Will Crystals of the desired Aspect, and the gem will drink deeply.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Right-click while holding a Sentient Tool to recalibrate it to the dominant Aspect in your inventory.[#]()
The [#](8B0000)Resonance of the Faceted Crystal[#]() ritual in action.

Unleashing [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() into the atmosphere has proven most fruitful, empowering [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() and producing [#](8B0000)Crystal Clusters[#]() of satisfying geometry. Yet these raw crystals feel somehow... [#](4A0080)conflicted[#](), as though warring natures strain against one another within.\
\
A certain [#](8B0000)Ritual[#]() may coax these hidden facets into purer forms...

Your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() attune to whichever Aspect you carry in greatest quantity. Ten Corrosive Will in one [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() and a thousand Raw in another means the blade remains Raw.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Hellfire Forge accepts any Aspect of Will for crafting, so there is no need to juggle multiple gems between stations.[#]()

Each Aspect also transforms the behavior of your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]():

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Pure damage increase.

- [#](8B0000)Corrosive Will[#](): Strikes may inflict poison or wither. Otherwise identical to Raw.

- [#](8B0000)Vengeful Will[#](): Moderate damage increase, heightened attack speed, and a movement speed boon that intensifies with greater Will reserves.

- [#](8B0000)Steadfast Will[#](): Moderate damage increase, and slaying a foe grants you a protective shield of Absorption.

- [#](8B0000)Destructive Will[#](): The greatest raw damage of any Aspect, at the cost of reduced attack speed.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.chunk_:
[#](2E8B57)The Aura is chunk-based.[#]() Will burned in one chunk fills only that chunk, up to a cap of [#](B8860B)100[#]() for each Aspect. Measure the local concentration with a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Aura Gauge[#]().\
\
To move Will across distances, place a [#](8B0000)Spira Infernalis[#]() in an adjacent chunk. It draws Will toward itself, and multiple pylons can be chained for long-distance transfer.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.crucib: Feed it a charged [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), loose [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), or [#](8B0000)Demon Crystals[#]() of any Aspect. Crystals are consumed once the chunk's Will dips below 50; Will in item form or from a gem is consumed gradually as needed.
The [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() with a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() smoldering within.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.descri: Saturating the world with demonic intent through the Vas Maleficum.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.forge_:
Placing a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() inside a [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() causes it to rapidly siphon Will from the surrounding Aura.\
\
With an Aspected Will present in the chunk and an empty gem in the Forge, you can fill that gem with a specific Aspect, allowing you to reshape the behavior of your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() and [#](8B0000)Sword[#]() accordingly. The effects of each Aspect are detailed in the [#](8B0000)Aspects of Will[#]() entry.
[#](4A0080)Demonic Will[#]() coalesces naturally around certain creatures, but it can also exist in a diffused state throughout the very air. By burning Will in a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#](), you release it into the [#](4A0080)Aura[#](), an invisible miasma that permeates each chunk of the world, ripe for exploitation.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.name: The Spiritus Aura
The pylon pulls all varieties of Will from each adjacent chunk (not including diagonals). Chain several together to create conduits spanning great distances.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.aura.uses.t:
With Raw Spiritus now saturating the atmosphere, certain [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() stir to greater potency. The true prize, however, is the ability to grow [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystals[#]() and from there, split them into their constituent [#](8B0000)Aspects[#]().\
\
Once you possess [#](8B0000)Aspected Will Crystals[#](), burn them in the [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() to flood the Aura with their particular resonance.
A spectral instrument for reading the Aura's hidden currents.

The overlay appears at the top-left of your vision. The colored bars offer a quick estimate of each [#](4A0080)Aspect's[#]() concentration in the current chunk.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Hold sneak for a precise numerical reading; values range from 0 to 100 for each Aspect. 100 is the maximum a single chunk can contain.[#]()

The [#](4A0080)Aura[#]() is invisible to the naked eye, but the trained practitioner need not rely on guesswork. While the [#](8B0000)Spiritus Aura Gauge[#]() rests in your inventory, it projects a spectral reading onto your vision.\
\
From top to bottom, the bars measure:

- Raw

- Corrosive

- Steadfast

- Destructive

- Vengeful
See overleaf for an image of the gauge's spectral overlay.
A portable reservoir for Essentia Vitae and other vital fluids.

The [#](8B0000)Blood Tank[#]() is a portable reservoir, capable of holding [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() and other fluids. Fill or drain it by right-clicking with a bucket or similar vessel. The tank faithfully retains its contents when broken, making it ideal for transporting large volumes between locations.\
\
It glows faintly according to its contents. Each tier doubles the previous capacity, beginning at [#](B8860B)16 Buckets[#]() and reaching a staggering [#](B8860B)524,288 Buckets[#]() at tier 16.
[#](2E8B57)Each tier doubles the previous tier's capacity, so reinforce early and often. A few tiers of upgrading can mean the difference between a trickle and a torrent.[#]()

Combine two [#](8B0000)Blood Tanks[#]() with [#](8B0000)Glass[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Bloodstone[#]() in a crafting table. The resulting tank rises one tier above the primary input, and both tanks' fluid contents merge together.\
\
If both tanks hold the same fluid, volumes are added. If only one contains fluid, the result retains it. If they hold different fluids, the primary tank's contents take precedence.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.composite_f: A layered filter that weaves multiple sorting rules into one.
Quantity limits and Allow/Deny modes function as with the Standard Filter. Additional controls appear in the interface as you layer more filter types onto the composite.

The [#](8B0000)Composite Item Filter[#]() is inert on its own, a blank canvas awaiting instruction. Combine it with another filter type in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() to layer that filter's rules onto this one.\
\
This allows you to weave complex conditions: use the Enchantment Filter's 'any enchantment' rule alongside the Tag Filter's 'forge:swords' to permit only enchanted blades through.
Combine a Tag, Enchantment, or Mod Filter with the Composite in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() to merge their logic together.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.crystallize: This device slowly draws [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the [#](8B0000)Aura[#]() and condenses it into physical [#](8B0000)Will Crystals[#](). The first spire demands 100 Will to form; each subsequent growth costs 45, yet yields 50 when burned in a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#](), a net gain of 5 per spire. A cluster may grow up to 7 spires tall.
Condensing raw malice from the Aura into physical crystal.

If you carry more than [#](B8860B)512 total Will[#]() in your inventory (across any number of [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gems[#](), of any single type), you may harvest these crystals by right-clicking the cluster with an empty hand. This strips all but the central spire.\
\
[#](2E8B57)In a hurry, or desperate for that last crystal? A pickaxe will shatter the entire cluster at once.[#]()

Now that your [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() brims with [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), you may wonder what happens when that malice is unleashed upon the world itself. The answer begins with saturating the [#](8B0000)Aura[#](), and continues with the [#](8B0000)Crystallarium Maleficum[#]().

Five Will per harvest is a modest return, but rituals such as the [#](8B0000)Resonance of the Faceted Crystal[#](), the [#](8B0000)Catalyst of the Forsaken Souls[#](), and the [#](8B0000)Crack of the Fractured Crystal[#](), alongside [#](8B0000)Will Catalysts[#](), can accelerate and automate crystal production to impressive effect.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.editing_fil: Should you wish to wipe a filter clean and start anew, place it alone in a crafting table.
A single configured filter placed alone in a crafting table yields a blank filter with all settings restored to their defaults.
Place one configured filter in the first slot, and blank filters of the same type in any remaining slots. The result: perfect copies with all settings faithfully duplicated.
Duplicating and clearing filter configurations with ease.

When configuring many [#](8B0000)Filters[#]() to identical specifications, the tedium of hand-setting each one grows tiresome. Instead, place between two and nine filters into a crafting table; the filter in slot one imprints its configuration onto all the rest.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.enchant_fil: Sorting items by the magical bindings wrought upon them.
Note the two additional buttons beside the Allow toggle.

The [#](8B0000)Enchantment Item Filter[#]() sorts items by the magical bindings wrought upon them. It shares the Standard Filter's quantity and Allow/Deny functions, augmented with additional controls for enchantment matching.

The first button selects whether to match [#](B8860B)every enchantment[#]() on an item, [#](B8860B)any enchantment[#](), or [#](B8860B)one particular enchantment[#](). The second determines whether level matters (e.g. 'Protection III' vs 'Protection' at any level).\
\
[#](2E8B57)Insert an unenchanted item to create a blanket rule for any sort of enchantment, useful for separating enchanted gear from mundane.[#]()
Any enchanted book suffices as a crafting component for this filter.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.explosive_c:
Each charge can be further enhanced by [#](8B0000)Anointing[#]() it with certain reagents and a measure of Will:

- [#](B8860B)Fortunate[#](): broken blocks yield Fortune loot.

- [#](B8860B)Heated Tool[#](): broken blocks are smelted on the spot.

- [#](B8860B)Soft Touch[#](): broken blocks are affected by Silk Touch.

- [#](B8860B)Voiding[#](): worthless debris is annihilated rather than dropped.

A direct improvement. Destroys a [#](B8860B)7x7x7[#]() cube on the impacted face, and may be anointed with [#](B8860B)Fortune II[#]() as well.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Augmented Shaped Charge

Destroys only blocks [#](B8860B)identical to the block it strikes[#](), seeking outward from the point of impact. Consumes up to 3 stacks of matching blocks.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Controlled Charge

Functions identically to the standard Controlled Charge, but devours up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of matching blocks.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Controlled Charge II

Purpose-built for timber. Strike a log or leaf block, and up to [#](B8860B)two stacks[#]() of wood come crashing down, with leaves stripped away in the process. Even the mightiest jungle giants fall in moments.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Deforester Charge

The greater variant. Fells up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of logs, shearing away all connecting leaves. Ideal for carving clearings in Dark Oak forests or dense jungles.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Deforester Charge II
Compact demolition devices fueled by Will and enhanced by anointment.

Designed for the great mushrooms of the Overworld and the Nether. Capable of consuming up to [#](B8860B)three stacks[#]() of fungal material, though you would be hard-pressed to find a specimen that large.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Fungal Charge

The greater fungal variant. Annihilates up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of mushroom material in a single detonation.\
\
Why you would ever need such overkill is a question best left to the practitioner's conscience.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Fungal Charge II

Mining by hand and felling trees one swing at a time; such drudgery is beneath a practitioner of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](). You have devised something far more elegant: compact charges of compressed Will that detonate on contact. Hurl them at offending stone, timber, or anything else you wish unmade, and wait for the satisfying ignition.
Explosive Charges
Explosive Charges

Obliterates a [#](B8860B)5x5x5[#]() cube on the face it strikes, dropping all blocks as though mined with a pickaxe. It cuts through Obsidian with ease and provides a most gratifying concussion.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Shaped Charge

Bores a [#](B8860B)5x5x20[#]() corridor straight through whatever it strikes. An invaluable companion for deep excavation.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Tunnelling Shaped Charge
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.filter_part: The essential framework upon which all routing filters are built.
[#](8B0000)Filter Parts[#]() are the skeletal framework upon which every [#](8B0000)Filter[#]() is constructed. They serve no purpose alone, but no filter can be forged without them.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.hellfire_fo: The infernal anvil where Spiritus is shaped into power.

The [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() stands as a second pillar of the art, twin to the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() itself. Where the altar works with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), the Forge consumes [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), reshaping raw malice into [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#](), [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gems[#](), [#](8B0000)Arcane Ash[#](), reagents, and many things besides.\
\
No practitioner of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() can progress far without one.
A broad filter that matches all items sharing a common origin.

The [#](8B0000)Mod Item Filter[#]() accepts up to 9 representative items. For each item you place within it, [#](B8860B)every item from the same origin[#]() is matched, allowing you to permit or deny entire collections at once.\
\
Quantity limits and Allow/Deny modes function as with the Standard Filter.
Particularly useful for directing all artifacts of a given discipline into their own dedicated vault, ensuring your [#](4A0080)Vitaemantic[#]() instruments never mingle with lesser materials.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.name: Spiritus & Artifice
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.node_router: The binding wand that weaves Routing Nodes into networks.

The [#](8B0000)Node Router[#]() is the weaver's needle that stitches your [#](8B0000)Routing Nodes[#]() into a coherent network. Its use is straightforward; hold sneak and right-click on one node, then do the same to another within 16 blocks. The two are now linked.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Right-click any other block to deselect. See the Routing Nodes entry for the full picture.[#]()
A slender wand of bound Will. Unremarkable in appearance, indispensable in practice.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.routing_nod:
A [#](4A0080)Routing Network[#]() comprises three elements: [#](8B0000)Input Nodes[#](), [#](8B0000)Output Nodes[#](), and a single [#](8B0000)Master Routing Node[#]().\
\
Every network requires exactly one Master. All other nodes must trace a path back to it, whether directly or through intermediaries.\
\
Input and Output Nodes interact with any adjacent block that supports item, fluid, or energy transfer.
An arcane logistics network for items, fluids, and energy.

When placed, an Input or Output Node automatically detects all adjacent inventories, but it remains dormant without a [#](8B0000)Filter[#]() in at least one of its directional slots. For example: a [#](8B0000)Standard Item Filter[#]() set to Iron Ore atop a Furnace, a coal filter on its side, and an Input Node beneath pulling Iron Ingots.

Routing Nodes move more than items; they transfer [#](8B0000)fluids[#]() and [#](8B0000)Forge Energy[#]() as well. Any side with a filter installed automatically routes all three resource types to compatible adjacent blocks.\
\
A filter facing a [#](8B0000)Blood Tank[#]() allows [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() to flow through the network; one facing a machine's power input transfers energy.
Fluid & Energy Routing

Fluid and energy routing share the same priority system as items. The [#](8B0000)Stack Upgrade[#]() increases transfer rates for all three simultaneously.\
\
[#](2E8B57)No special filter configuration is needed for fluids or energy; any routing filter in the slot enables transfer for all resource types on that side.[#]()

On the right: directional buttons: [#](8B0000)D[#]()own, [#](8B0000)U[#]()p, [#](8B0000)N[#]()orth, [#](8B0000)S[#]()outh, [#](8B0000)W[#]()est, [#](8B0000)E[#]()ast. A small block icon appears on sides facing attached inventories.\
\
The interface opens to the side facing an inventory, or Down if none is present. Button orientation follows your facing direction; the top button is always 'forward.'

On the left: a slot for one [#](8B0000)Filter[#]() per side, and a [#](B8860B)Priority[#]() value. Higher numbers are served first.\
\
Select the desired side, insert your filter, and the node knows what to move and where.
Open the node's interface to configure its connections.

Hauling materials by hand is beneath a blood mage of your stature. With [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() at your command, you have devised [#](8B0000)Routing Nodes[#](), an arcane logistics network that transports, sorts, and filters [#](8B0000)items[#](), [#](8B0000)fluids[#](), and [#](8B0000)Forge Energy[#]() through invisible channels at your decree.
Routing Nodes
The working hands of the network; one draws in, the other sends forth.
Input & Output Routing Nodes
The brain of your network. It accepts upgrades to improve throughput and speed, but for now it serves a single vital purpose: directing all traffic.
Master Routing Node
Routing Nodes
Nodes need not connect directly to the Master; only to some node on the network.
An Output Node manifested in the world.
A passive relay. Unremarkable alone, but essential for bridging distances between active nodes in your [#](4A0080)Routing Network[#]().
Routing Node

A Master alone accomplishes nothing. [#](8B0000)Input Routing Nodes[#]() draw resources into the network; [#](8B0000)Output Routing Nodes[#]() deliver them to their destination. Plain [#](8B0000)Routing Nodes[#]() serve as relays, extending the network's reach beyond the 16-block limit of a single connection.

Once your Input and Output Nodes are placed, linked via a [#](8B0000)Node Router[#]() to a network containing exactly one [#](8B0000)Master Routing Node[#](), and each has a filter installed to the correct side, the network awakens. Resources flow according to priority and filter rules.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.sentient_sw: A Will-devouring blade that reaps essence from the slain.

The [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]() is a far more elegant instrument of Will collection than the [#](8B0000)Soul Snare[#]() could ever aspire to be. It may feel sluggish when first drawn; the blade feeds on the Will you carry, growing sharper with every fragment. A [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() brimming with Will is essential to unlocking its true potential.\
\
[#](2E8B57)As with all Sentient equipment, the sword may be repaired with Crystallized Will in an Anvil.[#]()

This weapon shall serve you well in the hunts to come.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Right-click to recalibrate the blade's attunement. Do this after acquiring a large quantity of Will, or when experimenting with a new Aspect for the first time.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.sentient_to: Without Will, merely a step above its [#](8B0000)Iron[#]() ancestor. With a brimming [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), it rivals, and surpasses, [#](8B0000)Netherite[#]().

Much like the pickaxe, the [#](8B0000)Sentient Axe[#]() scales dramatically with the Will you carry. It also receives a significant boost to its damage, making it a formidable weapon for those who do not mind its heft.
Will-hungry implements that grow stronger as your reserves deepen.

The success of the [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]() has inspired further experimentation. If a blade can be imbued with [#](4A0080)demonic will[#](), why not a pickaxe? An axe? A shovel?\
\
[#](2E8B57)All Sentient equipment can be repaired with Crystallized Will in an Anvil, and all are highly receptive to enchantment.[#]()

Without Will to sustain it, this pick is scarcely better than the [#](8B0000)Iron Pickaxe[#]() from which it was wrought. Feed it, however, fill your [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() to the brim, and it shall surpass even [#](8B0000)Netherite[#](), cleaving through stone as though it were clay.

Starved of Will, the scythe is blunt and unwieldy. Fed generously from a full [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), it becomes a devastating instrument of reaping.\
\
[#](2E8B57)It still functions as a hoe, for the practical-minded.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Sentient Scythe[#]() is a beast of a different nature. The infusion of Will has transmuted it from a humble farming tool into a fearsome weapon. Though slower and less devastating per blow than the sword, its sweeping arc delivers full damage to every creature caught within its reach, ideal for carving through hordes.
Humble in its unpowered state, transcendent when gorged on Will. With a full [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), earth and gravel part before it like water.
The [#](8B0000)Sentient Shovel[#]() follows the same pattern as its kin, a noticeable improvement over iron even without additional [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() to empower it.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus.de: The malevolent essence bound within all mortal creatures.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus.in:
Every creature that walks, crawls, or slithers through the dark carries within it a shard of [#](4A0080)demonic intent[#](), a residue left when entities of the lower planes imbue their malice into mortal flesh. This essence is known as [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), and it is yours to harvest.\
\
There are two methods of extraction:

- Strike a hostile creature with a [#](8B0000)Soul Snare[#](), then slay it while spectral motes still cling to its form.

- Fell it outright with a [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus.ne: Once you have gathered some Will, the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() awaits, eager to transmute this raw malice into instruments of power. Should loose fragments begin to clutter your person, a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() will serve as a most convenient receptacle.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus.us:
As a fledgling Vitaemancer, you will not yet possess a [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#](), so the [#](8B0000)Soul Snare[#]() shall serve as your first instrument of collection.\
\
[#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() is a cornerstone of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](), fueling the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() and the creation of ever more potent artifacts. Where [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is the currency of the blood, [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() is the currency of the soul.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus_ge: This intricate gem holds an impressive [#](B8860B)1,024 Will[#](). A worthy vessel for a practitioner of growing renown.

Your [#](8B0000)Lesser Spiritus Gem[#]() is a noted improvement, yet once more you press against its limits. Further refinement demands an [#](8B0000)Imbued Slate[#]() from the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), combined with another [#](8B0000)Diamond[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Block of Gold[#](), quadrupling capacity once again.
Crystalline vessels that imprison and compress Spiritus.
This masterwork of [#](4A0080)vitaemantic[#]() artifice holds an astounding [#](B8860B)4,096 Will[#](). Few vessels in existence can rival its containment.

The [#](8B0000)Common Spiritus Gem[#]() is a fine achievement, yet you sense the limits of mortal craft closing in. To break through demands the culmination of all you have learned; a [#](8B0000)Demonic Slate[#](), a [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shard[#](), and a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal[#]().\
\
The rewards, however, shall be commensurate. Your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() will reach potencies you have only dreamed of...

The fragments of [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() you have gathered thus far are potent, yet unwieldy. What you require is a vessel, a crystalline prison to contain and compress that malice into something manageable. The [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() is precisely such an artifact.\
\
Better still, the gem hungers. Drop loose Will upon the ground nearby, and the gem will devour it of its own accord.

This reinforced gem holds up to [#](B8860B)256 Will[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)When upgrading, the Forge draws Will from the gem being crafted before tapping the gem in its Gem Slot. The newly forged gem retains any leftover Will from the process.[#]()

Your [#](8B0000)Petty Spiritus Gem[#]() has served its purpose, but its capacity chafes against your ambitions. By working it with [#](8B0000)Diamond[#](), [#](8B0000)Lapis[#](), and [#](8B0000)Redstone[#]() within the Forge, you have discovered a method to quadruple its containment.

Your first vessel holds a modest [#](B8860B)64 Will[#](), crude, but far more practical than loose fragments rattling about your pack.\
\
[#](2E8B57)To transfer Will between gems, right-click while holding the gem you wish to empty. Its contents flow into the first valid gem in your inventory.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.spiritus_sn: Binding spectral thread to pry Spiritus from hostile creatures.
A skeleton wreathed in spectral motes after being struck by a Snare.

[#](8B0000)Soul Snares[#]() are your gateway into the deeper mysteries of [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). These delicate constructs of thread and intent are forged upon the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() at its most basic tier.

The method is simple enough; prepare a generous supply of [#](8B0000)Snares[#]() and hurl them at [#](8B0000)hostile creatures[#](). Pale, spectral motes will gather around the afflicted target; this is the moment to strike. Upon death, the creature yields its [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Looting enchantment increases the Will dropped.[#]() Once you have collected a few fragments, turn your attention to forging a [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](); these will make the harvest far more efficient.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.standard_fi: Precise control over which items flow through your network.
The filter interface, showing a configured layout and its tooltip.

The [#](8B0000)Standard Item Filter[#]() allows you to designate up to 9 specific items for a [#](8B0000)Routing Node[#]() to interact with. Each slot accepts a quantity; leave it blank to default to 'all.'\
\
The filter also toggles between [#](B8860B)Allow[#]() and [#](B8860B)Deny[#]() modes. In Deny mode, quantities are ignored.

When installed in an [#](8B0000)Output Routing Node[#](), the quantity sets how many of each item to fill into the adjacent inventory. Surplus remains in the network, passed onward to another valid destination, or held in place.

When installed in an [#](8B0000)Input Routing Node[#](), the quantity determines how many of each item to leave behind in the adjacent inventory. Anything above that threshold is drawn into the network.
Sorting items by their hidden categorical bindings.
The filter interface, showing tag selection and tooltip.

The [#](8B0000)Tag Item Filter[#]() sorts items by their associated [#](B8860B)Tags[#](), the invisible categories that bind similar materials together. As with the Standard Filter, it supports up to 9 entries, quantity limits, and Allow/Deny modes.\
\
For each item placed into this filter, you may choose to match [#](8B0000)one specific tag[#]() or [#](8B0000)any of its tags[#]().
This enables broad categorical sorting. Specify that all items tagged as [#](8B0000)forge:ores[#]() flow to your furnace, for instance, and never manually sort another pebble again.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.throwing_da: Matches the Iron dagger in damage but yields no Will from kills. Its true purpose lies elsewhere: eight Amethyst daggers combined with a [#](8B0000)Lingering Alchemy Flask[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() produce [#](8B0000)Tipped Amethyst Throwing Daggers[#]().
Razor-edged projectiles that harvest Will, Essence, or deliver alchemical ruin.

Bows and crossbows serve their purpose well enough, but sifting through gravel for flint and plucking chickens for feathers is, frankly, beneath a Vitaemancer of your caliber. These razor-edged [#](8B0000)Throwing Daggers[#]() require no ammunition and carry some rather devious secondary effects.

A swift, precise strike dealing [#](B8860B)10 damage[#]() with a moderate cooldown. If you carry [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), loose or within a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), slain creatures drop Will as though felled by a [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]().

Crush these delicate vials near an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to transfer [#](B8860B)500 EV[#]() directly into the altar, destroying the ampoule in the process. [#](2E8B57)This infusion is unaffected by Runes.[#]()

For the practitioner more interested in [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() than Will. Slightly less damaging and noticeably cheaper to forge, creatures slain by this weapon have a chance of yielding a [#](8B0000)Slate Ampoule[#](), or more, if the quarry is sufficiently hearty.

Each strike delivers the flask's effect to the target, as though it had walked through a lingering cloud. Experiment with combined alchemical effects to craft the most debilitating projectiles your ingenuity allows.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.upgrades.de: Enhancing the throughput and tempo of your arcane logistics.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.upgrades.in:
Two enhancements are currently available for the [#](4A0080)Routing Network[#]().\
\
The [#](8B0000)Basic Routing Logic Upgrade[#]() increases the volume of resources moved per operation. By default, the network transfers [#](B8860B)16 items[#](), [#](B8860B)1,000 mB of fluid[#](), and [#](B8860B)10,000 FE[#]() per cycle. Each upgrade raises all three caps simultaneously.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.upgrades.lo: Stacks to 64. The increased throughput is distributed across all active transfers in the network.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.upgrades.sp: The second enhancement is the [#](8B0000)Basic Routing Speed Upgrade[#](), which quickens the network's pulse. The default rate is one operation every [#](B8860B)20 ticks[#]() (one second). Each upgrade reduces this by one tick, to a minimum of every single tick with 19 upgrades.
Stacks to 19, one for each tick that can be shaved from the cycle. A peculiar limit, perhaps, but the fabric of reality can only be bent so far.
book.neovitae.guide.spiritus.will_cataly:
Fortunately, the entire process can be automated, freeing your hands for worthier pursuits.\
\
Begin with four [#](8B0000)Will Crystals[#]() of the same type: Raw, Steadfast, Destructive, Vengeful, or Corrosive.
Five variants exist, one for each Aspect of Will. Forge them in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]().

While holding a [#](8B0000)Will Catalyst[#]() of the matching Aspect, right-click a [#](8B0000)Crystal Cluster[#]() to supercharge its growth.\
\
Each catalyst reduces the Will cost per spire from 45 to just [#](B8860B)25[#](), and accelerates growth tenfold. One dose fuels ten spires of growth, yielding a net bonus of [#](B8860B)200 Will per Catalyst[#]().

Forge a cluster from four matching crystals in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](), then place it in any chunk suffused with Will of the same Aspect. In time, new spires crystallize and grow, just as they do atop a [#](8B0000)Crystallarium Maleficum[#]().
Supercharging crystal growth for automated Will production.

A second application extends the effect to 20 growths rather than 10, though it provides no other benefit.\
\
The astute blood mage will note this merely trades one manual task, slaying monsters, for another, anointing crystals.

Naturally, there is a ritual for that. The [#](8B0000)Gathering of the Forsaken Souls[#]() automatically applies catalysts to any clusters within its reach.\
\
With the right farms and a sufficiently ingenious [#](8B0000)Routing Node[#]() configuration, the entire apparatus runs itself, top to bottom. The precise arrangement, however, is left as an exercise for the ambitious.

The [#](8B0000)Crack of the Fractured Crystal[#]() ritual automates the breaking of excess spires, and the [#](8B0000)Call of the Zephyr[#]() gathers the dropped crystals.\
\
With a basic [#](8B0000)Routing Node[#]() system, you can even feed surplus crystals back into a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() for a self-sustaining loop.\
\
There is, however, a drawback: this process is slow. Each crystal sprouts a new spire once every few minutes, consuming nearly as much Will as it yields, roughly [#](B8860B)1 Will per minute per spire[#]().

If [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() has one flaw, it is the tedium of collection. Even armed with a nearly full [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), a [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]() bearing [#](8B0000)Looting III[#]() and [#](8B0000)Plunderer's Glint II[#](), the harvest remains a manual labor, and you have far grander designs to attend to.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.anointm: Alchemical coatings for tools and weapons.

Where flasks empower the body, [#](8B0000)Anointments[#]() empower the hand. These are [#](4A0080)alchemical coatings[#]() for your tools, weapons, and [#](8B0000)Charges[#](). Hold the anointment in one hand and press Use to apply it to the item in your other hand. Not every coating suits every instrument; choose wisely.\
\
Unlike elixirs, anointments are not governed by time. They diminish with each use of the coated tool, fading stroke by stroke until spent.

The [#](8B0000)Slate-infused Vial[#]() is prepared at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/slate_vial). Ordinary glass cannot withstand the reactive compounds within an anointment. This vial, reinforced with powdered slate, contains what lesser vessels cannot.

An [#](8B0000)anointment[#]() may also be applied via a smithing table, where it takes the place of a smithing template. This proves especially useful for two-handed weapons and other situations where one's hands are otherwise occupied.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.bow_pow:
[#](8B0000)Iron Tip[#]() weights each arrow with an alchemical density, increasing its damage by 25%%. The effect stacks with existing enchantments.\
\
Valid items: Bows, Crossbows.\
\
Applies: Heavy Shot (256 shots)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.bow_vel:
[#](8B0000)Archer's Polish[#]() reduces friction along the bowstring and arrow shaft, launching projectiles at 50%% greater velocity. The increased speed translates directly into proportionally greater damage. Stacks with existing enchantments.\
\
Valid items: Bows, Crossbows.\
\
Applies: Sniping (256 shots)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_b:
The [#](8B0000)Bounce[#]() elixir transforms the body into a living spring. Where you would shatter against stone, you instead rebound skyward, unharmed and exhilarated.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Crouch before impact to suppress the bounce and land normally.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_f: A ward against flame and heat.

The [#](8B0000)Fire Resistance[#]() elixir wraps the drinker in an invisible ward that repels flame and heat. Lava itself becomes no more threatening than lukewarm water, though one should not grow complacent.
The pinnacle of gravitational alchemy, true flight.

The [#](8B0000)Flight[#]() elixir is the crowning achievement of [#](4A0080)gravitational alchemy[#](), true, unfettered flight, as free as the wind itself. Higher levels grant greater speed through the air.\
\
To synthesize it, brew both [#](8B0000)Suspended[#]() and [#](8B0000)Levitation[#]() into a single flask, then fuse them with a [#](8B0000)Combinational Catalyst[#]() at the Tabula Vitae.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_g: Intensifies the earth's pull to crushing force.

The [#](8B0000)Gravity[#]() elixir intensifies the earth's pull upon the drinker, causing them to plummet faster and suffer greater harm on impact. Jump height remains unchanged, small comfort on the way down.\
\
To synthesize it, brew both [#](8B0000)Grounded[#]() and [#](8B0000)Slow Falling[#]() into a single flask, then fuse them with a [#](8B0000)Combinational Catalyst[#]() at the Tabula Vitae.
Anchors the body, suppressing all jumping.

The [#](8B0000)Grounded[#]() elixir anchors the body to the earth, utterly suppressing the ability to jump. Swimming remains unaffected; the binding is to stone, not water.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Jump Boost[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_h: Stiffens flesh and armour with alchemical rigidity.

The [#](8B0000)Hard Cloak[#]() elixir stiffens the wearer's skin and armour alike, granting 3 points of Armour Toughness per level. Blows that would pierce through find an unexpected resilience beneath.
A leaden weight that drags the victim earthward.

The [#](8B0000)Heavy Heart[#]() elixir fills the chest with a leaden weight that drags the victim steadily downward. Flight becomes a desperate struggle. Swimming becomes a slow drowning.\
\
To synthesize it, brew both [#](8B0000)Gravity[#]() and [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() into a single flask, then fuse them with a [#](8B0000)Combinational Catalyst[#]() at the Tabula Vitae.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_i: Vitality inverted into a bolt of arcane harm.

The [#](8B0000)Instant Damage[#]() elixir is vitality inverted, a concentrated bolt of [#](4A0080)arcane harm[#]() that inflicts 6 points of magic damage per level. The [#](8B0000)undead[#](), paradoxically, find succour in it, healing 6 points per level instead.\
\
Derived from a flask of either [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() or [#](8B0000)Poison[#]().
A surge of raw vitality, instant and potent.

The [#](8B0000)Instant Health[#]() elixir is no gentle salve; it floods the body with raw vitality, restoring 4 health per level in an instant. Against the [#](8B0000)undead[#](), this same vitality becomes anathema, dealing 4 points of harm per level instead.
Bends light to conceal the flesh from sight.

The [#](8B0000)Invisibility[#]() elixir bends light around the drinker's flesh, rendering them unseen. Be warned: armour and held items remain stubbornly visible. A floating sword is hardly subtle.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_j: Coils the legs to leap beyond mortal limits.
The [#](8B0000)Jump Boost[#]() elixir coils the legs with stored energy, increasing jump height by 50%% per level. The same force cushions landings, reducing fall damage by 1 point per level.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_l: Reverses gravity's pull, sending the body skyward.

The [#](8B0000)Levitation[#]() elixir reverses the pull of the earth, causing the drinker to rise helplessly skyward. Higher levels accelerate the ascent. Use with care; what goes up must eventually come down.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Slow Falling[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_n: Attunes the eyes to pierce any darkness.

The [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]() elixir attunes the eyes to the faintest glimmers of light, rendering darkness and murky water as clear as a sunlit meadow. An indispensable companion for the practitioner who ventures deep.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_o: A mantle of volcanic hardness against physical harm.

The [#](8B0000)Obsidian Cloak[#]() elixir sheathes the body in an invisible mantle of volcanic hardness, reducing all non-magical damage by 20%% per level. Arrows glance. Blades skid. Only [#](4A0080)arcane forces[#]() bypass it.\
\
Brewed by combining a flask of [#](8B0000)Hard Cloak[#]() with [#](8B0000)Diamond[#]() and [#](8B0000)Crying Obsidian[#]() at the Tabula Vitae.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_p:
The [#](8B0000)Passive[#]() elixir extinguishes aggression from a creature's mind, rendering it docile and harmless. Even the most savage beast becomes as meek as a lamb.\
\
[#](2E8B57)This effect does not work on players; their will is too strong to be so easily quelled.[#]()
A wasting venom that gnaws but does not kill.

The [#](8B0000)Poison[#]() elixir introduces a wasting venom that gnaws at the target's vitality. It cannot kill on its own; the victim will linger at death's threshold, weakened and vulnerable. Higher levels hasten the decay.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_r: The [#](8B0000)Regeneration[#]() elixir knits torn flesh and mends broken bone, restoring health steadily over time. Higher levels hasten the mending; wounds close almost as fast as they are inflicted.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_s: Loosens gravity's grip to a gentle drift.
The [#](8B0000)Slow Falling[#]() elixir loosens gravity's grip, allowing the drinker to drift gently earthward like a feather on still air. All fall damage is negated entirely.
Slow Falling
Slow Falling
Thickens the blood, deadening the limbs.

The [#](8B0000)Slowness[#]() elixir thickens the blood and deadens the limbs, reducing movement speed by 15%% per level. An effective tool for hindering pursuers or fleeing prey alike.\
\
Derived from a flask of either [#](8B0000)Speed[#]() or [#](8B0000)Jump Boost[#]().
Slowness
Slowness
Opens the inner eye to perceive all nearby life.

The [#](8B0000)Spectral Sight[#]() elixir opens the [#](4A0080)inner eye[#](), revealing the outline of every living creature within 24 blocks as a luminous silhouette. Higher levels extend this perception by an additional 32 blocks per level. Nothing hides from such sight.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]().
Spectral Sight
Spectral Sight
Quickens the stride beyond mortal pace.
The [#](8B0000)Speed[#]() elixir quickens the drinker's stride, increasing movement speed by 20%% per level. Even a single dose transforms a cautious walk into a predator's lope.
Speed
Speed
Surges the body with unnatural might.
The [#](8B0000)Strength[#]() elixir floods the muscles with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), adding 3 points of attack damage per level. What was once an even fight becomes decidedly one-sided.
Strength
Strength
Severs the body from gravity's dominion.

The [#](8B0000)Suspended[#]() elixir severs the drinker's connection to gravity entirely. You cannot jump. You cannot fall. You simply exist at whatever height you currently occupy, sliding along an invisible plane as though the world were made of glass.\
\
Derived from a flask of [#](8B0000)Gravity[#]().
Suspended
Suspended
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.flask_w: Grants the lungs dominion over water.
The [#](8B0000)Water Breathing[#]() elixir grants the lungs the ability to draw air from water itself. Depths that would drown a lesser soul become your domain.
Saps the muscles, rendering strikes feeble.
The [#](8B0000)Weakness[#]() elixir saps the muscles of their vigour, reducing attack damage by 4 points per level. A creature so afflicted strikes with all the force of a child.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.fortune: Coaxes greater yield from harvested blocks.

[#](8B0000)Fortuna Extract[#]() coaxes the earth into yielding more than it should. The coating stacks with the Fortune enchantment for truly bountiful harvests.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords, Charges.\
\
Applies: Fortunate (256 blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.hidden_: Draws hidden experience from the earth.

[#](8B0000)Miner's Secrets[#]() draws forth hidden knowledge from the stone. Blocks that normally release experience yield an additional 2 points per harvest. The coating is consumed only when this bonus experience is actually extracted.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords.\
\
Applies: Miner's Secrets (256 exp-dropping blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.holy_wa: Sears the undead with purifying radiance.

[#](8B0000)Holy Water[#]() sears the profane. Blades anointed with it strike the undead with an additional 5 points of searing damage, a purifying flame they cannot endure.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords.\
\
Applies: Holy Light (256 hits)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.looting: Draws greater spoils from the slain.

[#](8B0000)Plunderer's Glint[#]() draws forth spoils from the slain that would otherwise remain hidden. The coating stacks with the Looting enchantment.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords.\
\
Applies: Plundering I (256 hits)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.melee_a: Hones the blade to a lethal keenness.

[#](8B0000)Honing Oil[#]() sharpens the edge of any blade it touches to a lethal keenness, adding 3 points of melee damage per strike.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords.\
\
Applies: Whetstone I (256 hits)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.name: Tabula Vitae
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.potion_: Should your current brews prove insufficient, the answer lies in deeper materials. With [#](8B0000)Glow Berries[#](), [#](8B0000)Cobbled Deepslate[#](), and a measure of [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#](), you may forge catalysts of considerably greater potency, pushing both duration and power well beyond their former limits.
Advanced Catalysis

The [#](8B0000)Standard Lengthening Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/average_lengthening). It extends the topmost effect's duration from a mere 3:00 to a formidable 21:20. Across eight doses, that is a truly staggering span of sustained power.
Standard Lengthening

The [#](8B0000)Standard Power Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/average_power). A concentrated refinement of its lesser counterpart, it drives effects to [#](B8860B)level III[#]() potency, though the duration contracts to a brief 45 seconds per dose. Devastating, but fleeting.
Standard Power Catalyst

Central to the art of flask-brewing are [#](8B0000)Catalysts[#](), reagents that shape and amplify your elixirs. Begin with these three: the [#](8B0000)Simple Catalyst[#](), the [#](8B0000)Small Power Catalyst[#](), and the [#](8B0000)Small Lengthening Catalyst[#](). The first serves as the foundation for nearly every alchemical brew, much as [#](8B0000)Nether Wart[#]() anchors lesser potions.

The [#](8B0000)Combinational Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/combinational). This is the reagent of [#](4A0080)synthesis[#](); it fuses two existing effects within a flask into an entirely new one. A flask bearing both [#](8B0000)Suspended[#]() and [#](8B0000)Levitation[#](), when treated with this catalyst, yields the coveted elixir of [#](8B0000)Flight[#]().
Combinational Catalyst

The [#](8B0000)Simple Cycling Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/cycling_catalyst). It rotates the order of effects layered within a flask, bringing a different effect to the top position, and thus changing which effect is targeted by subsequent catalysts or agents.
Simple Cycling Catalyst
Flask-brewing, catalysts, and the layering of effects.

A vessel, however fine, is nothing without something to fill it.\
\
Beyond the familiar elixirs, [#](8B0000)Water Breathing[#](), [#](8B0000)Regeneration[#](), [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]() , the discipline offers far stranger brews: [#](8B0000)Flight[#](), [#](8B0000)Obsidian Cloak[#](), even [#](8B0000)Passive[#](). Each is documented in the pages that follow.

The [#](8B0000)Weak Filling Agent[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/weak_filling). It replenishes a partially drained flask, though at a cost; only the topmost effect survives the restoration. All others are lost.\
\
[#](2E8B57)If you wish to preserve a deeper effect, first reorder the flask with a Simple Cycling Catalyst.[#]()
Weak Filling Agent

The [#](8B0000)Alchemy Flask[#]() is forged upon the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() (recipe: neovitae:ara_vitae/alchemy_flask). Far sturdier and more capacious than any common bottle, it holds eight doses of whatever elixir you fill it with, a vessel truly befitting the art.
Alchemy Flask

Potion-brewing is a pedestrian art. Any hedge-witch with a cauldron can boil nether wart into a serviceable tincture. But a [#](4A0080)Vitaemancer[#]() does not settle for serviceable.\
\
By weaving [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into the brewing process, you transcend the crude limitations of conventional alchemy entirely.
The Alchemist's Craft

Through ingenious [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](), you have learned to imbue common glass with far greater capacity than any bottle should rightly hold. More remarkable still, the use of specialized [#](8B0000)Catalysts[#]() allows you to layer multiple effects within a single flask without them muddying together or cancelling one another out.\
\
The result is an elixir worthy of the name.

The [#](8B0000)Small Lengthening Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/mundane_lengthening). It stretches the duration of the topmost effect within a flask, much as [#](8B0000)Redstone[#]() prolongs a common potion.\
\
As with Power Catalysts, if the topmost effect cannot be further extended, the catalyst seeks the next eligible effect below it.
Small Lengthening Catalyst

Layering multiple effects within a single flask is elegantly simple. Brew your first elixir, then use the resulting flask in place of an empty one for the second brewing.\
\
For example, brew a flask of [#](8B0000)Bounce[#](), then use that same flask as the base for a [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]() recipe. The result: an 8-dose flask bestowing both [#](8B0000)Bounce[#]() and [#](8B0000)Night Vision[#]() with every sip.
The Alchemist's Craft

The [#](8B0000)Small Power Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/mundane_power). It intensifies the topmost effect within a flask at the cost of shortened duration, analogous to what [#](8B0000)Glowstone[#]() achieves in cruder potions.\
\
If the topmost effect cannot accept further potency, the catalyst reaches deeper, boosting the next eligible effect in sequence.
Small Power Catalyst
Once you have drained a flask to its dregs, simply rinse it with water to prepare a fresh vessel for your next concoction. [#](2E8B57)Consult JEI for the refilling recipe.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Simple Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/simple_catalyst). It forms the alchemical bedrock of nearly every flask recipe. [#](2E8B57)Prepare these in quantity; you will consume them ceaselessly.[#]()
Simple Catalyst

Not every elixir need be sipped. Flasks may be transmuted into projectile forms:\
\
[#](8B0000)Splash Alchemy Flask[#]() (recipe: neovitae:flask/flask_splash)
[#](8B0000)Lingering Alchemy Flask[#]() (recipe: neovitae:flask/flask_lingering)\
\
A [#](8B0000)Lingering Flask[#]() may be combined with 8 [#](8B0000)Amethyst Throwing Daggers[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() to forge [#](8B0000)Tipped Amethyst Throwing Daggers[#](). Any creature struck by such a dagger suffers the flask's effects on impact.

The [#](8B0000)Strengthened Catalyst[#]() is brewed at the Tabula Vitae (recipe: neovitae:alchemytable/strengthened_catalyst). A refined alchemical substrate that serves as the foundation for all advanced-tier catalysts.
Strengthened Catalyst
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.quick_d: Hastens the draw of ranged weapons.

[#](8B0000)Dexterity Alkahest[#]() loosens the mechanism and limbs of ranged weapons, reducing draw time by 33%%. In the heat of battle, those fractions of a second are the difference between life and death.\
\
Valid items: Bows, Crossbows.\
\
Applies: Deft Hands I (256 shots)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.silk_to:
[#](8B0000)Soft Coating[#]() wraps the tool's edge in a preserving membrane, allowing blocks to be harvested whole rather than shattered. Does not stack with the Silk Touch enchantment.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords, Charges.\
\
Applies: Soft Touch I (256 blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.smeltin: Smelts blocks on contact through residual heat.

[#](8B0000)Slow-burning Oil[#]() infuses the tool with a smouldering heat that smelts blocks the instant they are broken. Ore becomes ingot in a single swing.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords, Charges.\
\
Applies: Heated Tool I (256 blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.tabula_: [#](2E8B57)When studying recipes in these pages or through JEI, hover over the arrow marked with a EV label to reveal the drain cost, crafting time, and required tier.[#]()
A transmutation workbench fuelled by EV from your Anima.

Should the table refuse to work, the cause is almost certainly one of these:

- [#](8B0000)Orb Error[#](): No [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() is present, or the orb's [#](B8860B)tier[#]() is insufficient for the recipe you attempt.

- [#](8B0000)Anima Error[#](): The orb is adequate, but it has not been bound to you (right-click to bind), or your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() lacks sufficient [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() to fuel the transmutation.\
\
The following pages catalogue several fundamental recipes available through the Tabula Vitae.

Along the right edge of the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() interface, you will find six directional glyphs: [#](8B0000)D[#]()own, [#](8B0000)U[#]()p, [#](8B0000)N[#]()orth, [#](8B0000)S[#]()outh, [#](8B0000)W[#]()est, and [#](8B0000)E[#]()ast.\
\
Select any slot within the table, then toggle these glyphs to permit or deny external conduits, hoppers, pipes, and the like, access from that face. Click the slot once more to deselect it and return to normal operation.
The glyph displayed within each slot reveals whether it currently accepts incoming materials or provides outgoing products to external conduits.

The [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() is a workbench of transmutation, drawing [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() to reshape matter itself. The [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() tapped and the [#](B8860B)tier[#]() of recipes available are governed by the [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() socketed into its right-hand slot.\
\
Through this instrument, the Vitaemancer transmutes base materials into reagents, catalysts, and components essential to the art.

Even the simplest transmutations have their uses. The Tabula Vitae can produce:

- [#](8B0000)Grass Block[#]() from barren earth

- [#](8B0000)Leather[#]() purified from rotten flesh

- [#](8B0000)Bread[#]() from raw grain

- [#](8B0000)Clay[#]() drawn from sand

- [#](8B0000)String[#]() and [#](8B0000)Cobweb[#]()

As your skill deepens, so does the table's repertoire:

- [#](8B0000)Plant Oil[#]() extracted from wheat, carrots, potatoes, or beets

- [#](8B0000)Coal Sand[#]() and [#](8B0000)Explosive Powder[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Flint[#]() coaxed from gravel

- [#](8B0000)Saltpeter[#]() and [#](8B0000)Gunpowder[#]()

A cunning Vitaemancer may place a [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() or [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() within the Tabula Vitae to conjure [#](8B0000)Lava Buckets[#]() or [#](8B0000)Water Buckets[#]() without consuming the sigil. Furthermore, a [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#]() may substitute for a [#](8B0000)Water Bucket[#]() in any recipe the table accepts, a small convenience that saves many trips to the well.
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.voiding:
[#](8B0000)Void Essence[#]() consigns worthless materials to oblivion the instant they are broken, stone, dirt, netherrack, and other mundane refuse simply cease to exist.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords, Charges.\
\
Applies: Voiding I (256 blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.tabula_vitae.weapon_: Mends the tool with every stroke.

[#](8B0000)Repairing Salve[#]() mends as it works. Each use of the coated tool restores 1 point of durability, allowing favoured instruments to endure far longer than nature intended.\
\
Valid items: Tools, Swords.\
\
Applies: Regular Maintenance I (256 blocks)
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.atha:
With the Sanguine Reverter, the Athanor can unmake:

- [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Orb[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Apprentice Blood Orb[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Magician Blood Orb[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Master Blood Orb[#]()
- Netherite Ingot
- Any Reinforced Rune (to base materials)
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.auto:
[#](2E8B57)The Athanor is sided, much like a common furnace. Tools may only enter or exit from the top. Inputs are accepted from the sides. Outputs emerge from the bottom.[#]()\
\
Keep this geometry in mind when placing your Hoppers or Routing Nodes. An automated Athanor is the heart of any serious ore-processing chain.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.desc: The alchemist's crucible: smelter, ore tripler, and instrument of unmaking.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.intr:
The [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() is the alchemist's furnace, a vessel of transmutation that transcends mere smelting. Within its crucible you may triple ore yields, revert Blood Orbs, unmake Netherite and Reinforced Runes, and - most critically - distill [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shards[#]() from [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Most tools placed in the Athanor degrade over time, but Unbreaking or Mending enchantments will slow or halt their decay.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.name: The Athanor
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.reve: Every Reinforced Rune placed in the Athanor alongside the Sanguine Reverter surrenders its form and returns to base materials. This is invaluable when restructuring your altar, apprentice - no investment need be permanent.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.athanor.sang: Forged within the Hellfire Forge, the [#](8B0000)Sanguine Reverter[#]() is a tool of [#](4A0080)unmaking[#](). It peels away the enchantments of creation, reducing Blood Orbs, Netherite, and Reinforced Runes back to their constituent materials. It is also the instrument by which Weak Blood Shards are born from Saturated Tau.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.bloodstone_b: Stone steeped in life force - decorative, and essential for the fourth altar.

[#](8B0000)Bloodstone Bricks[#]() are stone saturated with crystallized life force, dark and warm to the touch. Beyond their unsettling beauty, they serve as the [#](B8860B)capstones for the Tier IV Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
Their creation requires [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shards[#](), obtained by placing [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#]() into the Athanor with a Sanguine Reverter.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.book_experie:
With the Curios API present, you may equip the Tome as a charm upon your person, freeing your hands for more pressing matters.\
\
[#](2E8B57)If you find yourself wanting more charm slots, the Sigil of Holding or the Socketed Upgrade for Living Armour may serve you well.[#]()
A repository for experience, safe from the grasp of death.

The [#](8B0000)Tome of Peritia[#]() is a vessel for captured wisdom. Within its pages, your accumulated experience crystallizes into a form that cannot be lost to death.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Sneak and Use to store one level. Use alone to retrieve. Hold either action to transfer multiple levels rapidly.[#]()
Consult JEI for the recipe of the [#](8B0000)Tome of Peritia[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.utility.essentia_vit: Drawing the refined essence from the altar in liquid form.

[#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is potent within the Ara Vitae, where it fuels crafting and flows through your Orb into the [#](4A0080)Anima[#](). But what if you wish to place it in the world - to fill a moat around your Incense Altar, perhaps?\
\
Simply place an empty Bucket in the Ara Vitae while it holds at least 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The altar fills the vessel in moments. One unit of EV equals one millibucket.

Place a Bucket in the Ara Vitae with at least 1,000 EV to receive a [#](8B0000)Bucket of Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
It is emphatically not blood. Blood would have coagulated long ago.\
\
...Why are you looking at me like that, apprentice?
book.neovitae.guide.utility.getting_star: A map of the Vitaemancer's journey, from first blood to final mastery.

So you wish to walk the path of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](). Very well. This grimoire shall guide you from your first tentative cuts to the mastery of forces that reshape reality itself.\
\
What follows is an overview of the journey ahead, tier by tier, so that you may orient yourself amid the mysteries to come.
The Path Before You
The Path of Ascension

The [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() draws [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() through the Blood Orb placed within, channeling it into a myriad of creations:

- [#](8B0000)Arcane Ashes[#]() for array work
- Reagents for Sigil crafting
- Anointments for your blades
- 2x Ore Processing
- Various esoteric sundries
The Tabula Vitae (Tier I)

Your first act as a Vitaemancer is to construct an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Sacrificial Knife[#](). With blade in hand, you offer your own blood to the altar, and it drinks deeply, refining it into [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Use this to forge a [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Orb[#](), several [#](8B0000)Blank Slates[#](), and a handful of [#](8B0000)Soul Snares[#]().
The Ara Vitae (Tier I)

Scatter [#](8B0000)Arcane Ashes[#]() upon the ground, and a circle of power awakens. This is the [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() - a versatile glyph that accepts two offerings.\
\
Some combinations yield crafted objects, such as the [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#](). Others invoke immediate effects upon the world, bending time or light to your will.
Alchemy Arrays (Tier I)

The [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() is fueled by [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#]() - that strange substance torn from slain creatures with your Soul Snares. A [#](8B0000)Sentient Sword[#]() harvests it far more efficiently.\
\
From this forge spring [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gems[#](), Sentient Tools, Explosive Charges, and Throwing Daggers.
The Hellfire Forge (Tier I)

[#](B8860B)Tier II[#]() grants the [#](8B0000)Dagger of Sacrifice[#](), a blade that lets you harvest [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from slain creatures, sparing your own veins. Upgrade Runes become available for the Ara Vitae, and new Sigils emerge.\
\
As always, continue expanding and upgrading your altar. Its hunger grows with your ambition.
The Second Tier

Should the altar's construction grow tiresome, a welcome diversion awaits. The potioncrafting system opens at [#](B8860B)Tier II[#](), allowing you to prepare [#](8B0000)Alchemy Flasks[#]() or tip your [#](8B0000)Amethyst Throwing Daggers[#]() with dozens of potent effects.\
\
A Vitaemancer with a well-stocked flask belt is never truly in danger.
Potioncrafting (Tier II)

At [#](B8860B)Tier III[#](), the true scope of Vitaemancy reveals itself. You gain the ability to inscribe [#](4A0080)Rituals[#]() and forge [#](8B0000)Living Armour[#]() - equipment that grows stronger through the trials you endure.\
\
Turn your attention to upgrading both the Ara Vitae and your [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]() to unlock more potent rites. But how?
The Third Tier

By performing the [#](4A0080)Edge of the Hidden Realm[#](), you tear a wound in the veil and gain limited passage into the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](). There, among the horrors, you may find [#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#]().\
\
Cultivate it into [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#](), then refine it within the Athanor to produce [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shards[#]() - the key to the fourth tier, stronger Anointments, and Potion Catalysts.
Dungeoneering (Tier III)

[#](B8860B)Tier IV[#]() unlocks the [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner [Dusk][#](), and with it, a vast repertoire of advanced rites. Automate your [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() supply, soar in unfettered flight within your sanctum, or call down a devastating [#](4A0080)meteor[#]() laden with precious bounty from the heavens above.
The Fourth Tier

Your [#](8B0000)Living Armour[#]() may have begun to feel constrained by its modest point cap. With the Dusk Diviner, you may now perform the [#](4A0080)Ritual of Living Evolution[#](), raising your armour's capacity from [#](B8860B)100[#]() to [#](B8860B)300[#]() points.
Living Evolution (Tier IV)

The [#](4A0080)Sound of the Cleansing Soul[#]() strips upgrades from your armour, producing [#](8B0000)Upgrade Tomes[#]() that may be copied into a [#](8B0000)Training Bracelet[#](), or re-applied to ensure you train only the upgrades you desire.\
\
Surplus tomes serve as fuel for the [#](4A0080)Penance of the Leaden Soul[#](), a rite that inscribes [#](4A0080)Downgrades[#]() onto your armour.
Mastering Upgrades

Downgrades are costly, and each exacts a heavy toll upon the body. Yet their negative point cost frees room for greater upgrades.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Favour resilience over agility? Try Body Builder V, Brilliance V, Healthy X, and Tough X combined with Leadened Pick X and Limp Leg X.[#]()
The Price of Power

[#](2E8B57)Prefer speed and exploration? Perhaps Strong Legs X, Quick Feet X, and Crippled Arm suit you better.[#]()\
\
Craft multiple chestplates and swap between them as the situation demands. Dozens of upgrades and downgrades exist - experiment freely, apprentice. The armour responds to your will.
Many Configurations

The [#](4A0080)Pathway to the Endless Realm[#]() tears open a permanent gate into the demon dimension. Come armed and armoured - the realm does not suffer the unprepared.\
\
Delve deep enough, and you may unearth [#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#](), which in block form serves as capstone for the ultimate altar tiers, alongside the [#](8B0000)Archmage's Blood Orb[#]().
The Demon Realm (Tier IV)

Investigate the [#](8B0000)Ritual Tinkerer[#]() and the various [#](4A0080)Aspects of Spiritus[#]() now available. These aspects can refine your rituals and reshape how your Sentient Tools behave.\
\
To progress beyond this threshold, however, a deeper plunge into the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() awaits...
Aspected Will (Tier IV)

[#](B8860B)Tier V[#]() grants access to the most devastating rituals and the most potent crafting recipes in all of Vitaemancy.\
\
Continue your expeditions into the Demon Realm. With fortune, you may recover [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#](), which, combined with Netherite Scrap, can double the power of every rune upon your altar.
The Fifth Tier

The [#](B8860B)ultimate Ara Vitae[#](). [#](4A0080)Crystal Clusters[#]() crown its pillars, and an immense ring of nineteen runes per side girds its foundation.\
\
At this zenith, the altar's capacity for [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() and its crafting power are without equal. You stand at the pinnacle of Vitaemancy, apprentice. What you do with that power is yours to decide.
The Sixth Tier
book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.ani:
Your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() is the invisible reservoir woven into the fabric of your very soul. Every Vitaemancer possesses one, unique and untouchable by others. Items bound to you draw from and replenish this wellspring.\
\
The capacity of your Anima is determined by the tier of your [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#](). Greater orbs hold vastly more EV.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.blo: [#](8B0000)Blood[#]() is the raw, unrefined substance found coursing through every living creature. When you draw a blade across your flesh, or when the [#](8B0000)Dagger of Sacrifice[#]() claims a life, it is this crude vitality you offer to the Ara Vitae for purification.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.des: The language of Vitaemancy - terms every practitioner must know.
