book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.ess:
[#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is blood that has been sanctified within the Ara Vitae - refined into a luminous crimson fluid of considerable power. It pools in the altar's basin, may be siphoned with Dislocation Runes, drawn into a bucket, or consumed in altar crafting.\
\
When this grimoire speaks of the altar's capacity or contents, it refers to Essentia Vitae.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.key: Vitaemancy has its own language, forged over centuries by practitioners who understood that naming a thing grants power over it. Study these terms well, apprentice - you will encounter them throughout this grimoire and in practice.
Throughout this grimoire and in conversation among practitioners, [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is often shortened to [#](4A0080)EV[#](). Whether it pools in the basin of your Ara Vitae or flows invisibly through your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](), it is the same substance, the refined essence of life.\
\
EV is consumed when activating Sigils, empowering Rituals, and fueling the Tabula Vitae.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.glossary.ref:
To distill the essence of this lexicon:\
\
- [#](8B0000)Blood[#]() (raw): torn from living flesh by blade or sacrifice
- [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() (refined): sanctified within the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#](), pooling as luminous crimson fluid\
\
The Ara Vitae transmutes blood into EV. A [#](8B0000)Blood Orb[#]() placed within draws that EV into your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](), where it fuels your instruments across any distance.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.cl:
The cell's waters can coax clay from the driest materials:

- Sand to Clay (requires Water)
- Terracotta to Clay (requires Water)
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.co:
All sixteen hues of Concrete Powder can be solidified into Concrete within the Athanor using the Hydration Cell and Water - a far tidier method than dumping powder into a stream.\
\
White, Light Gray, Gray, Black, Brown, Red, Orange, Yellow, Lime, Green, Cyan, Light Blue, Blue, Purple, Magenta, and Pink.

The cell accelerates the slow breath of oxidation upon copper, advancing it through each stage:

- Copper Block to Exposed, Exposed to Weathered, Weathered to Oxidized
- Cut Copper through all oxidation stages
- Cut Copper Stairs through all stages
- Cut Copper Slab through all stages\
\
All copper oxidation requires Water.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.de: The Hydration Cell saturates, dissolves, and transforms within the Athanor.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.dy:
The Hydration Cell's waters can strip dye from woven and vitreous materials:

- Beds (any colour to white)
- Wool (any colour to white)
- Carpet (any colour to white)
- Glass (stained to clear)
- Glass Panes (stained to clear)\
\
All dye removal requires Water.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.in:
Fitted with a [#](8B0000)Primitive Hydration Cell[#](), the Athanor becomes a font of elemental water, saturating and transforming matter at the molecular level. Ensure you supply it with Water, or the cell thirsts in vain.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Hydration Cells degrade with use, but Unbreaking or Mending enchantments extend their service considerably.[#]()
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.mo:
The cell's persistent moisture encourages moss growth upon worked stone:

- Cobblestone to Mossy Cobblestone
- Cobblestone Stairs to Mossy Cobblestone Stairs
- Cobblestone Slab to Mossy Cobblestone Slab
- Cobblestone Wall to Mossy Cobblestone Wall
- Stone Bricks to Mossy Stone Bricks
- Stone Brick Stairs to Mossy Stone Brick Stairs
- Stone Brick Slab to Mossy Stone Brick Slab
- Stone Brick Wall to Mossy Stone Brick Wall
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.mu:
Further transmutations the cell enables:

- Dirt to Mud (requires Water)
- [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#]() to [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shard[#]() (requires [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]())
book.neovitae.guide.utility.hydration.re: Among its many uses, the Hydration Cell can produce Clay - the [#](4A0080)Cornerstone of Balance[#]().
book.neovitae.guide.utility.incense_alta:
[#](2E8B57)Place the altar upon a 3x3 platform of solid blocks (this foundation is important for later expansion). Remain within five blocks of the altar to receive its blessing.[#]()\
\
When the altar awakens, flame particles dance from its crown and your [#](8B0000)Sacrificial Knife[#]() begins to shimmer. Holding and releasing the blade near an Ara Vitae will then sacrifice 90%% of your health in a single, potent offering.
Constructing the Focus

The Tranquility bonus is bounded by the path tier you employ:

- [#](B8860B)No Path:[#]() 20%%
- [#](B8860B)Wooden Path:[#]() 60%%
- [#](B8860B)Stone Path:[#]() 120%%
- [#](B8860B)Worn Stone Path:[#]() 200%%
- [#](B8860B)Obsidian Path:[#]() 300%%
Ceiling of Serenity
A meditative focus that deepens the sacrifice through Tranquility.
[Image: A simple Incense Altar setup. Note the optional mixing of different path blocks.]
A Garden of Calm
[Image: Incense HUD, default in top left corner, showing a self-sacrifice bonus of +20%%.]
Reading the Signs

The [#](8B0000)Incense Altar[#]() is a meditative focus - a multiblock apparatus that stills the mind and opens the veins. When you stand within its calming aura and draw your blade, the surrounding [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#]() deepens the sacrifice, multiplying the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() gained from self-offering.
The Incense Altar
Incense Altar

Each path material carries its influence only so far: [#](8B0000)Wooden[#]() paths extend three rings, [#](8B0000)Stone[#]() paths five, [#](8B0000)Worn Stone[#]() paths seven, and [#](8B0000)Obsidian[#]() paths nine rings from the centre.\
\
Not every block contributes Tranquility. You require growing things, earth, and even... lava?
Path Reach

Each successive ring of path blocks obeys ancient geometric constraints:

- All path blocks in a single ring must share the same elevation.
- The next ring may differ by no more than five blocks in height from the previous.
- Blocks at ring level or up to two blocks above it contribute their [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#]() to the total.
Laws of the Path Rings

To deepen the area's [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#](), you must lay sacred paths radiating outward from the altar in all four cardinal directions. Each path is three blocks wide and constructed from consecrated [#](8B0000)Path blocks[#](), extending from the 3x3 foundation.
Walking Paths of Peace
Consult JEI for the [#](8B0000)Incense Altar[#]() recipe.
[Image: Basic setup showing the 3x3 square of blocks before the path blocks.]
Foundation Layout

The strength of your enhanced sacrifice scales with the area's total [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#](). Hover over the Incense Altar with a [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() or [#](8B0000)Seer's Sigil[#]() to reveal two readings: the total Tranquility above, and the percentage bonus below.\
\
When you sacrifice, your normal yield is multiplied by (1 + bonus/100).
The Weight of Tranquility

Blocks that resonate with [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#](): Lava, Water (including most waterlogged blocks), Essentia Vitae, Netherrack, Dirt, Farmland, Potatoes, Carrots, Wheat, Nether Wart, Beetroots, Leaves, Logs, Fire, and Grass.\
\
[#](2E8B57)For advanced setups, cultivate as many different types as possible.[#]()
Contributing Blocks

Seven categories of [#](4A0080)Tranquility[#]() exist: [#](2E8B57)Plants, Crops, Trees, Earthen, Water, Fire, and Lava[#]().\
\
The altar surveys all blocks within its range, tallies each type, then takes the square root of each category's total and sums them. Diversity, not mere volume, is the key to great Tranquility.
Sources of Tranquility
book.neovitae.guide.utility.lava_crystal: A shard of eternal heat, fueled by the Anima.

The [#](8B0000)Lava Crystal[#]() is a shard of imprisoned heat, born from molten rock and sustained by the power of your [#](4A0080)Anima[#](). So long as [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() flows, it will never cool.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Use on any block in the world to ignite it, at a cost of 100 EV.[#]()

Place a Lava Crystal in the fuel slot of any furnace, and it becomes an inexhaustible flame, drawing 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per item smelted. Ten seconds of burn time per operation - exactly enough for one item.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.name: Utility Blocks & Items
book.neovitae.guide.utility.ore_processi: The apex of dissolution. This fluid persists sixteen times longer, doubles crafting speed, and doubles the probability of bonus yields. The [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#]() it requires lies buried in the deepest reaches of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]().
Advanced Cutting Fluid

With access to the Athanor and a Cutting Fluid, every mined ore block yields three portions of sand. This sand is then smelted into ingots as normal.\
\
The discipline rewards patience, apprentice. Refine in stages, and the earth gives up far more than it would to a common furnace.
The Athanor's Yield

[#](8B0000)Cutting Fluid[#]() is prepared in the Tabula Vitae and serves as the penultimate reagent in all ore processing chains.\
\
Within the Athanor, it dissolves an ore block into 3 portions of Ore Sand, or a raw ore into 1.5 on average. [#](2E8B57)A simple Bottle of Water may substitute for the Water Sigil in the recipe.[#]()
Basic Cutting Fluid
[#](8B0000)Tiny Corrupted Dust[#]() can be combined into full [#](8B0000)Corrupted Dust[#](), a potent catalyst that further amplifies ore yields. Consult JEI for the combination recipe.

Corrupted Dust merges with various materials in the Tabula Vitae to produce:

- [#](8B0000)Corrupted Coal[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Corrupted Iron[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Corrupted Debris[#]()
Corrupted Catalysts
Multiply your mineral wealth through cutting fluids, resonators, and the Athanor.

The [#](8B0000)Reinforced[#]() and [#](8B0000)Hellforged Explosive Cells[#]() are superior variants prepared in the Tabula Vitae. Each outlasts and outpaces the humble Explosive Powder, making them essential for sustained processing operations.
Explosive Cells

[#](8B0000)Explosive Powder[#](), prepared in the Tabula Vitae, shatters ore into fragments within the Athanor: 4.5 fragments per ore block, 2.25 per raw ore on average. It can also reduce ingots to their sand form.\
\
Netherrack, too, crumbles before it, yielding Sulfur and 50mb of Lava. Two improved variants exist.
Explosive Powder

Athanor recipes using Explosive Powder:

- Raw Ore to Ore Fragments (2.25 average)
- Ore Block to Ore Fragments (4.5 average)
- Netherrack to Sulfur + 50mb Lava
Fragments and Yields
The Athanor functions as a furnace, but accepts only two fuel sources: the [#](8B0000)Primitive Fuel Cell[#]() or a [#](8B0000)Lava Crystal[#]().

The Primitive Fuel Cell endures for 128 individual operations - more than double what the Block of Coal in its recipe would yield in a furnace. Better still, it consumes durability only upon completing a craft, wasting nothing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)An efficient Vitaemancer wastes neither blood nor fuel.[#]()
On Fuel Efficiency

The full processing chain within the Athanor:

- Ore Fragment to Ore Gravel (using Resonator)
- Ore Gravel to Ore Sand (using Cutting Fluid)
The Refinement Chain

A refined variant that endures eight times as long and hastens the Athanor's work by 50%%. The [#](8B0000)Tau Oil[#]() it demands, however, can only be found by those brave enough to [#](4A0080)delve into the demon realm[#]().
Intermediate Cutting Fluid

Blood has many uses, and among the most practical is the multiplication of mineral wealth. The [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() doubles your ore, while the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() can yield 2.5 ingots per raw ore, or 4.5 ingots per ore block.\
\
Every vein you mine becomes a bounty when viewed through the lens of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]().
The Alchemy of Ore
The Alchemy of Ore

Forged in the Hellfire Forge, the [#](8B0000)Resonator[#]() vibrates ore fragments into gravel for further refinement, producing [#](8B0000)Tiny Corrupted Dust[#]() as a byproduct. The [#](B8860B)Reinforced[#]() variant has 4x durability, and the [#](B8860B)Hellforged[#]() variant has 16x durability with doubled bonus outputs.
The Resonator

The Tabula Vitae can grind raw ore into metallic sand, effectively doubling your yield:

- Iron Sand from Raw Iron
- Gold Sand from Raw Gold
Metal Sand

Metal Sand yields ingots in a standard furnace:

- Iron Sand smelts into Iron Ingots
- Gold Sand smelts into Gold Ingots
Smelting Metal Sand
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.de: Bend space with blood - redstone-controlled spatial exchange.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.en: The [#](8B0000)Enhanced Teleposition Focus[#](), also forged in the Ara Vitae, widens the exchange to a 3x3x3 volume centred above the Teleposer. Entire small structures can be relocated in a single pulse.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.fo: The basic [#](8B0000)Teleposition Focus[#]() is crafted in the Ara Vitae. It commands a modest 1x1x1 exchange zone directly above each Teleposer - enough to transport a single entity or block with precision.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.in:
[#](8B0000)Teleposers[#]() bend space through the power of blood, swapping everything above two linked points - blocks, items, entities, even you - in the blink of an eye.\
\
Craft a [#](8B0000)Teleposition Focus[#](), bind it to a target Teleposer, place it in a second, and apply a redstone signal. The exchange is instantaneous.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.li:
Teleposers may be linked in many configurations: one-way (the receiving end stays inert), two-way (a Focus in each, swapping on either signal), or chained in sequence - A to B to C and back to A.\
\
From vertical elevators threading your tower to labyrinthine transit networks beneath the earth, the possibilities are boundless. Be creative, apprentice.
book.neovitae.guide.utility.teleposer.re: Nothing in [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() is free. Each block or entity transported costs 1 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per two blocks of distance, up to 1,000 per object and 10,000 total per activation.

[#](2E8B57)The Teleposer requires strong redstone power to activate. A redstone block placed adjacent will not suffice - you need redstone dust or a repeater pointing into its side, or a lever or button placed directly upon it.[#]()\
\
[#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() is not free, and the Teleposer is deliberately designed to minimize accidental misfires. Precision in all things.
The [#](8B0000)Reinforced Teleposition Focus[#]() commands a 5x5x5 volume - a formidable displacement field.
